items.title: DNA Directed Chemistry: Scalable Programmed DNA-Encoded Library Synthesis for More Chemically Diverse and Drug-Like Libraries
items.abstract_or_text: DNA-Encoded Libraries (DELs) are indispensable high-throughput platforms in drug discovery, but the widely adopted split-and-pool synthesis method is fundamentally limited: the DNA merely records, rather than directs, the steps of chemistry. This lack of programmatic control imposes mandatory downstream chemistry congruency, restricts structural diversity, and inevitably generates a combinatorial explosion of un-drug-like molecules, hindering both hit-finding and the acquisition of structurally informative data required for machine learning (ML) models. To resolve these core constraints, we developed Programmed DEL Synthesis (PDS), a robust, industrially applicable platform for non-combinatorial DEL construction in which the DNA actively directs the synthesis. PDS is built upon a sort-and-pool mechanism expanded by three key innovations: sequence-specific installation of first building blocks using charged carrier codons, a multinomial encoding strategy that enables libraries exceeding 20 billion unique encodings in three chemical steps, and non-combinatorial germline assembly that allows for the programmatic omission of undesirable building block combinations. We demonstrate the platform with Library i01, a three-step, threepathway library employing 137 trifunctional scaffolds. The design successfully programmed the systematic merging and un-merging of three mutually incompatible reaction pathways: Acid→Aldehyde→Amine, Amine→Aldehyde→Acid, and Aldehyde→Acid→Amine within a single synthesis. Pilot affinity selections against Carbonic Anhydrase (BCA-II) validated the high fidelity of DNA encoding and efficient building block installation across all steps and pathways, confirming the platform's robust utility for selection. PDS transforms chemical congruency and drug-likeness into programmable properties, offering a precise, efficient solution that improves library quality without sacrificing chemical space. Crucially, PDS enables the construction of structurally tailored 2nd Generation DELs needed to provide the high-resolution data required for productive ML-driven active learning cycles, establishing a critical operational link for modern drug development.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Programmed DEL Synthesis（PDS），让 DNA 主动指导非组合式 DNA-Encoded Library 合成；通过带电 carrier codons、multinomial 编码和可排除不理想组合的 germline assembly，支持三步合成中超过 200 亿种编码，并以 BCA-II 亲和筛选验证 Library i01。
items.why_it_matters_zh: PDS 将 DEL 的化学兼容性、药物样性和后续机器学习所需的数据结构纳入可编程设计，可能提高 hit finding 的有效信息量；但目前仅展示一套三步文库和 BCA-II 选择，命中物质量及其对主动学习的实际增益尚待验证。
items.abstract_zh: DNA-Encoded Libraries（DELs）是药物发现中不可或缺的高通量平台，但被广泛采用的 split-and-pool 合成方法存在根本限制：DNA 仅记录而不指导化学步骤。这种缺乏程序化控制的状态造成必须满足后续化学兼容性、限制结构多样性，并不可避免地产生组合爆炸式的大量非药物样分子，妨碍 hit finding，也妨碍获取机器学习（ML）模型所需的具有结构信息量的数据。为解决这些核心限制，我们开发了 Programmed DEL Synthesis（PDS），一种稳健、可用于工业的非组合式 DEL 构建平台，其中 DNA 主动指导合成。PDS 建立在 sort-and-pool 机制上，并由三项关键创新扩展：利用带电 carrier codons 按序列特异性安装第一批构建模块；采用 multinomial 编码策略，在 3 个化学步骤内实现超过 200 亿种独特编码的文库；以及采用非组合式 germline assembly，从而可程序化省略不理想的构建模块组合。我们以 Library i01 展示该平台：这是一个包含 137 个三官能团骨架、3 步、3 条路径的文库。该设计成功在单次合成中程序化合并和拆分了 3 条彼此不相容的反应路径：Acid→Aldehyde→Amine、Amine→Aldehyde→Acid 和 Aldehyde→Acid→Amine。针对 Carbonic Anhydrase（BCA-II）的试验性亲和筛选验证了所有步骤和路径中的高 DNA 编码保真度及高效构建模块安装，证实该平台可稳健用于筛选。PDS 将化学兼容性和药物样性转变为可编程性质，提供了一种精确、高效的方案，可在不牺牲化学空间的前提下改善文库质量。关键在于，PDS 能够构建为高效 ML 驱动主动学习循环提供高分辨率数据所需的结构定制化第二代 DELs，从而建立了现代药物开发中的重要操作联系。

items.title: @lanyon_ai：Formally verified magnetohydrodynamics, with provably hyperbolicity-preserving magnetic divergence error correction. Sim
items.abstract_or_text: Formally verified magnetohydrodynamics, with provably hyperbolicity-preserving magnetic divergence error correction. Simulating plasma vortices and supersonic plasma flows in arbitrary geometries using shock-capturing schemes for the equations of ideal MHD, all implemented and verified autonomously with Lanyon. ~32,000 lines of C, ~50,000 lines of Lean proof, ~150 correctness theorems, all generated in ~7 minutes. The ideal MHD equations couple the equations of hydrodynamics with Maxwell’s equations for electromagnetism to describe the interactions of perfectly conducting fluids with magnetic fields. As an elegant reduced-order description, the ideal MHD equations occur ubiquitously throughout heliophysics, geophysics, and astrophysical plasma physics, as well as in modeling the equilibrium and stability of nuclear fusion reactors. Solving these equations involves unique numerical and algorithmic challenges, including issues surrounding the preservation of divergence constraints for the magnetic field, as well as complex thermodynamic stability and wave-speed restrictions. Lanyon one-shotted an end-to-end formally verified solver for the ideal MHD equations, including a provably hyperbolicity-preserving divergence correction scheme based on the Dedner et al. approach, with fully executable mathematical, physical, and numerical correctness proofs. Then it ran a variety of complex numerical and physical validation simulations, and autonomously analyzed the results. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first ever fully formally verified divergence correction scheme for the MHD equations. GitHub link and technical deep dive below.👇

items.title: Neural Symbollic Regression Using Deep Learning and Sparse Modelling
items.abstract_or_text: Symbolic Regression (SR) seeks to find succinct mathematical expressions that represent the fundamental relationships within data, providing interpretability and scientific understanding that exceeds that of black-box models. Nevertheless, traditional methods like Genetic Programming face challenges with scalability and are highly sensitive to noise, while sparse regression techniques such as SINDy rely significantly on predetermined feature libraries. In this work, we present a Neural Symbolic Regression (NSR) framework that treats neural networks as functional preconditioners for symbolic discovery. Our approach uses a decoupled pipeline: a neural network first learns a smooth, noise-robust approximation of the target function in an interaction- aware nonlinear feature space. LASSO is then applied to extract sparse, interpretable closed-form expressions. To improve predictive accuracy and symbolic fidelity by integrating distributed hyperparameter optimization with Ray Tune and ASHA scheduling. Experiments on the Nguyen benchmark suite show that our approach consistently outperforms SINDy and non-tuned neural baselines in RMSE, noise robustness, and out-of-distribution generalization. Ablation studies confirm the significance of feature interactions, neural depth, and tuning strategies. In general, this study presents a scalable and understandable neural-symbolic framework, creating a solid link between neural approximation and the discovery of sparse equations for scientific machine learning.
items.summary_zh: Neural Symbolic Regression 先用神经网络拟合平滑、抗噪的目标函数近似，再以 LASSO 提取稀疏的封闭形式表达式；作者在 Nguyen 基准上与 SINDy 及未调优神经基线比较，并报告 RMSE、抗噪性和分布外泛化改善。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法面向可解释方程发现，并提供基准比较和消融；摘要中的性能结论限于所述 Nguyen 任务，不能据此推及一般科学发现。
items.abstract_zh: 符号回归（SR）旨在寻找能够表示数据内在基本关系的简洁数学表达式，从而提供超出黑箱模型的可解释性和科学理解。然而，遗传编程等传统方法面临可扩展性挑战，并且对噪声高度敏感；而 SINDy 等稀疏回归技术则显著依赖预先确定的特征库。在这项工作中，我们提出 Neural Symbolic Regression（NSR）框架，将神经网络视为符号发现的函数预条件器。我们的方法采用解耦流程：神经网络首先在交互感知的非线性特征空间中学习目标函数的平滑、抗噪近似，随后应用 LASSO 提取稀疏、可解释的封闭形式表达式。通过将分布式超参数优化与 Ray Tune 和 ASHA 调度相结合，以提高预测准确性和符号保真度。Nguyen 基准套件上的实验表明，我们的方法在 RMSE、抗噪性和分布外泛化方面持续优于 SINDy 和未调优的神经基线。消融研究确认了特征交互、神经网络深度和调优策略的重要性。总体而言，本研究提出了一个可扩展且可理解的神经符号框架，在神经近似与科学机器学习中稀疏方程的发现之间建立了坚实联系。

items.title: LLM Judges Verify Presence, Not Absence: Omission Blindness in AI Clinical Notes and What Recovers It
items.abstract_or_text: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes, and published audits find their dominant error is omission: information the encounter established that the note fails to record. The standard check is an LLM judge: a second model reads the note against the transcript and flags problems. We ask whether judges detect omissions. Public corpora cannot supply the answer key: their clinician reference notes and transcripts are materially discrepant. Our benchmark has 500 single-error note pairs from audited fact sheets, 298 with a named fact certainly absent and 202 added-or-altered controls. Across eight judge designs, paired discrimination (the flawed note below its clean twin, 0.5 a coin flip) reads 0.79-0.94 on added or altered content and 0.50-0.63 on omissions. On single notes, no design flags omissions reliably more often than perfect notes. Wording changes, voting and GEPA prompt optimisation move the operating point without creating usable detection. Restructuring the task recovers it: list the facts the transcript establishes, then check the note for each. Two methods reach it independently and trade off: a per-fact pipeline, and a GEPA-evolved prompt doing the same in one call. The pipeline's flags name the missing fact and its severity at 2.7% false alarms. The single call detects more (36.9% against 24.6%, p=0.002) at 6.2% false alarms and a tenth of the cost per note. A physician author validated 70 items and, where the two routes disagree, sided with the pipeline on 10 of 10 (p=0.002). A second clinician, not an author, graded the severity rubric blind and agrees to within a grade. On real vendor notes from a companion census no benchmark threshold transfers, but the re-calibrated single call detects more than the best of the eight at half its false-alarm rate. Omissions whose fact is restated elsewhere defeat both routes. We release the benchmark, prompts and judgements.
items.summary_zh: 500组经审计的单错误临床记录对显示，8种LLM评审设计对“遗漏”远弱于对添加或改动内容的识别；逐事实核查和GEPA演化提示词可部分改善该问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把临床文书AI的遗漏错误转化为可量化评测问题，并公布基准、提示词与判定结果；实际供应商记录上的阈值仍不可直接迁移。
items.abstract_zh: 环境式AI记录工具会起草临床记录，已发表审计发现其主要错误是遗漏：就诊中已确定的信息未被记录下来。标准检查方式是使用LLM评审器：第二个模型将记录与转录文本对照并标记问题。我们询问评审器是否能检测遗漏。公共语料库无法提供标准答案，因为其中临床医师参考记录与转录文本存在实质性差异。我们的基准包含500组来自经审计事实表的单错误记录对，其中298组含有确定缺失的具名事实，202组为添加或改动对照。在8种评审器设计中，配对判别率（将有缺陷记录排在其无缺陷配对之下，0.5为抛硬币水平）对于添加或改动内容为0.79–0.94，对于遗漏为0.50–0.63。在单条记录上，没有任何设计能可靠地比对完全记录更常标记遗漏。措辞改变、投票和GEPA提示词优化会改变操作点，却未产生可用的遗漏检测。重构任务后可改善该问题：先列出转录文本确定的事实，再逐项核查记录。两种方法分别实现这一思路，并存在权衡：逐事实流程，以及用一次调用完成同样工作的GEPA演化提示词。逐事实流程的标记会指出缺失事实及其严重程度，误报率为2.7%。单次调用检出更多遗漏（36.9%对24.6%，p=0.002），误报率为6.2%，每份记录成本为前者的十分之一。一名作者临床医师验证了70项；在两种方法结论不一致时，其在10项中的10项支持逐事实流程（p=0.002）。另一名并非作者的临床医师以盲法评估严重程度量表，其结果与前者相差不超过一个等级。在配套普查中的真实供应商记录上，没有基准阈值能够直接迁移，但重新校准后的单次调用以最佳8种设计一半的误报率检出更多遗漏。若某项事实在记录其他位置被重述，两种方法都会失效。我们发布基准、提示词和判定结果。

items.title: Rescuable Stagnation: A Diagnostic for Benchmark Suitability in LLM-Guided Materials Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly incorporated into closed-loop materials optimization, yet existing benchmarks provide little controlled evidence of what they contribute once Bayesian optimization stalls. We introduce a benchmark qualification criterion for rescue experiments—which we term rescuable stagnation—for determining, before the optimization comparison is run, whether a benchmark stalls while meaningful improvement remains available. Benchmarks that fail this test make it difficult to distinguish ineffective rescue strategies from saturated or non-stalling optimization. Qualifying a benchmark in advance therefore reduces the risk that null results reflect benchmark design rather than the method under evaluation. We demonstrate the approach on a benchmark constructed from Materials Project shear-modulus data, on which LLM-guided rescue gives no statistically significant improvement over heuristic injection—including a heuristic control provided with the same search information. The LLM nonetheless steers the search toward chemically distinct, high-modulus regions that conventional heuristics do not reach. This exploration behavior reproduces across two model capability levels and does not depend on the coherence of the model’s rationales, though it carries a substantially higher per-proposal cost. The LLM’s distinctive contribution on this benchmark is therefore in where it places exploration rather than in the optimization outcome it achieves, though this distinctiveness did not translate into a measurable advantage under the budget tested. More broadly, conclusions about LLM-guided discovery hinge on benchmark suitability—which qualifying the benchmark makes testable before experiments begin.
items.summary_zh: 提出“可挽救停滞”诊断，在比较 LLM 介导材料优化前确认基准是否会停滞且仍有可达改进；在 Materials Project 剪切模量数据构建的基准上，LLM 未显著优于同等搜索信息下的启发式注入，但探索到了不同的高模量化学区域。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把“基准是否适合检验方法”变成可检验问题，并以阴性结果避免夸大 LLM 优化能力；需要注意的是，其结论来自一个基准和给定预算，不能直接外推至实验闭环发现。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）正日益被纳入闭环材料优化，但一旦贝叶斯优化停滞，现有基准几乎没有提供关于 LLM 贡献的受控证据。我们引入了一项用于救援实验的基准资格判据——称为“可挽救停滞”——以便在运行优化比较之前，确定某一基准是否会停滞但仍存在有意义的改进空间。未能通过该检验的基准会使人难以区分无效的救援策略与已经饱和或不会停滞的优化过程。因此，预先确认基准资格可降低这样的风险：零结果反映的是基准设计，而非被评估的方法。我们在一个由 Materials Project 剪切模量数据构建的基准上展示了该方法；在该基准中，LLM 引导的救援相比启发式注入没有给出统计显著的改进，后者也获得了相同的搜索信息。尽管如此，LLM 确实将搜索引向传统启发式方法无法到达的、化学上不同的高模量区域。这种探索行为在两种模型能力水平上都能复现，且不依赖模型推理文本的连贯性，不过其每个提议的成本显著更高。因此，LLM 在该基准上的独特贡献在于它将探索放在何处，而非其取得的优化结果；但在所测试的预算下，这种独特性没有转化为可测量优势。更广泛地说，关于 LLM 引导发现的结论取决于基准是否合适，而对基准进行资格确认可使这一点在实验开始前得到检验。
items.author_line: Muhammad Asad

items.title: Accessible and reproducible deployment reveals the practical boundaries of single-cell foundation models
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell foundation models (scFMs) have been widely promoted as a unifying paradigm for transcriptomic analysis, yet whether large-scale pretraining translates into reproducible biological advantages remains unclear. Their adoption is further hindered by heterogeneous implementations, preprocessing requirements, and computational environments. Here we develop a unified, automated, and reproducible framework for standardized deployment and controlled evaluation of scFMs across datasets, computational environments, training regimes, and downstream analyses, substantially lowering the technical barriers to their use. Leveraging this framework, we systematically investigate thirteen scFMs alongside established methods across nearly one hundred datasets spanning diverse biological contexts. Our analyses reveal clear practical boundaries to scFM utility. First, increased model scale, architectural complexity, pretraining corpus size, or input encoding does not consistently translate into superior downstream performance. Instead, measurable properties of embedding geometry provide a model-agnostic, representation-level explanation for differences in zero-shot performance across diverse model families. Second, the benefits of pretrained representations depend strongly on the biological and supervision regime: scFMs provide their clearest advantages under extremely limited supervision, particularly for rare-cell annotation and open-set detection of source-absent cell states, whereas established methods remain competitive or preferable in most other settings. Task-matched analyses further show that scFM representations transfer inconsistently to spatial-domain recovery, while their gene embeddings capture broad functional relatedness without reliably recovering context-specific regulatory relationships. Together, these results establish that scFM utility is neither universal nor determined simply by model scale alone, but varies with learned representation geometry, biological context, and supervision. By combining reproducible deployment with large-scale empirical and mechanistic investigation, our framework provides a principled foundation for determining when foundation-model pretraining offers genuine practical value and when simpler approaches remain sufficient.
items.summary_zh: 统一的可重复部署框架比较13个单细胞基础模型与既有方法，覆盖近100个数据集，发现其优势主要出现在极低监督、罕见细胞标注和开放集细胞状态检测等任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这项大规模比较为单细胞基础模型何时值得采用提供了实证依据，也避免将模型规模直接等同于生物学效用。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基础模型（scFMs）被广泛宣传为转录组分析的统一范式，但大规模预训练是否能够转化为可重复的生物学优势仍不明确。异质的实现方式、预处理要求和计算环境进一步阻碍了它们的应用。我们在此开发了一个统一、自动化且可重复的框架，用于在数据集、计算环境、训练方案和下游分析之间对scFMs进行标准化部署和受控评估，显著降低其使用的技术门槛。借助该框架，我们在涵盖多种生物学背景的近100个数据集上，系统研究了13个scFMs及既有方法。分析显示，scFM效用存在清晰的实际适用范围。第一，模型规模增大、架构复杂度提高、预训练语料规模增加或输入编码变化，并不稳定地转化为更优的下游表现。相反，嵌入几何的可测性质为不同模型家族间零样本表现差异提供了与模型无关、表征层面的解释。第二，预训练表征的收益强烈依赖于生物学背景和监督方案：scFMs在监督极为有限时表现出最清晰的优势，特别是罕见细胞注释和源数据中缺失细胞状态的开放集检测；在多数其他情境中，既有方法仍具有竞争力或更适合。任务匹配分析进一步表明，scFM表征向空间域恢复的迁移并不稳定；其基因嵌入能够捕获广泛的功能相关性，却不能可靠地恢复情境特异性调控关系。综上，scFM效用并非普遍适用，也不能简单由模型规模决定；它会随所学表征几何、生物学背景和监督条件而变化。通过将可重复部署与大规模实证和机制研究结合，我们的框架为判断基础模型预训练何时带来真正的实际价值、何时较简单方法已足够提供了有原则的基础。
items.author_line: Hou, S., Yang, P., Ma, W., Xiang, J., Wang, J. X., Wan, H., Ma, Y., Zhou, X.

items.title: @rohanpaul_ai：New HuggingFace paper argues that increasing agent autonomy can gradually make human oversight ineffective by causing ap
items.abstract_or_text: New HuggingFace paper argues that increasing agent autonomy can gradually make human oversight ineffective by causing approval fatigue, overreliance, loss of situational awareness, and skill degradation. As agents do more, users are pushed into approval mode: skimming plans, granting permissions, and reconstructing what happened across steps. Over time, automation bias, approval fatigue, weaker situational awareness, and skill atrophy can make those approvals less reliable. Worse, weak approvals can become training or evaluation signals, rewarding systems for being easy to approve rather than easy to scrutinize. Their answer is cognitive scaffolding at 2 levels: developers add strategic friction, better approval design, behavioral monitoring, and checks that force attention at consequential moments. – arxiv. org/abs/2608.23642 Title: "AI Agents Push Humans Out of the Loop"
items.summary_zh: Rohan Paul 转述一篇题为《AI Agents Push Humans Out of the Loop》的论文：随着智能体承担更多工作，批准疲劳、过度依赖、情境感知减弱和技能退化可能削弱人工监督的可靠性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 帖文将“人在回路”从形式上的审批转向注意力与审查能力的问题。编辑认为，这个视角值得纳入智能体评估与交互设计讨论；文中结论仍应回到所链接论文的方法和证据核验。
items.abstract_zh: 一篇新的 Hugging Face 论文认为，提高智能体自主性会因批准疲劳、过度依赖、情境感知丧失和技能退化，逐步使人工监督失效。随着智能体完成更多工作，用户会被推向批准模式：略读计划、授予权限，并在多个步骤中重构发生了什么。久而久之，自动化偏见、批准疲劳、较弱的情境感知和技能萎缩会使这些批准更不可靠。更糟的是，薄弱的批准可能成为训练或评估信号，奖励容易获批的系统，而非容易审查的系统。他们的回答是在两个层面提供认知支架：开发者加入有策略的摩擦、更好的批准设计、行为监测，以及在关键时刻迫使人们投入注意力的检查。— arxiv.org/abs/2608.23642，题目：《AI Agents Push Humans Out of the Loop》。
items.author_line: Rohan Paul

items.title: SymFold: Synergizing Evolutionary and Structural Priors for Accurate Protein Inverse Folding
items.abstract_or_text: Protein inverse folding aims to recover amino acid sequences for a given 3D protein structure, underpinning broad applications such as enzyme engineering and drug discovery.Current methods often follow a serial pipeline, in which a structure encoder predicts a coarse sequence, which is then refined by protein language models (PLMs). However, because PLMs only perform post-hoc sequence edits, the refinement is bounded by the quality of upstream predictions.Thanks to recent multimodal protein language models (MPLMs), we could directly encode structure to generate sequences with pretrained structural knowledge, but we observe that they are not effective for inverse folding. Therefore, we introduce a symmetric dual-path architecture that both leverages PLMs for pretrained sequence evolution knowledge and MPLMs for pretrained structural knowledge to iteratively guide protein sequence generation.Through extensive experiments across standard protein inverse folding benchmarks, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior approaches, and ablation studies validate the rationale of our symmetric design, revealing a promising direction for the community.
items.summary_zh: 提出 SymFold 对称双路径架构，迭代结合 protein language models 的序列进化先验和 multimodal protein language models 的结构先验，以从给定 3D 蛋白结构生成氨基酸序列，并在标准 inverse folding 基准上报告 SOTA 结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将进化与结构知识在生成过程中共同利用，可能服务于酶工程和蛋白药物设计；但当前证据来自基准与消融实验，候选序列的稳定性、折叠和功能尚无实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质逆折叠旨在为给定的 3D 蛋白质结构恢复氨基酸序列，支撑酶工程和药物发现等广泛应用。当前方法通常遵循串行流程：结构编码器预测粗略序列，随后由蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）进行细化。然而，由于 PLMs 只进行事后序列编辑，细化效果受制于上游预测质量。得益于近期的多模态蛋白质语言模型（MPLMs），我们可以直接编码结构，并借助预训练结构知识生成序列，但我们观察到它们对逆折叠并不有效。因此，我们引入一种对称双路径架构，同时利用 PLMs 的预训练序列进化知识和 MPLMs 的预训练结构知识，迭代引导蛋白质序列生成。通过在标准蛋白质逆折叠基准上进行广泛实验，我们的方法取得了最先进性能，超过先前方法；消融研究验证了对称设计的合理性，并为该领域揭示了一个有前景的方向。
items.author_line: Handong Wang, Jiaxin Qi, Baisheng Lai, Jianqiang Huang

items.title: Site-Resolved Prediction of Mayr Nucleophilicity with Reactivity-Pretrained Graph Neural Networks
items.abstract_or_text: Nucleophilicity is a key kinetic descriptor for understanding organic reaction mechanisms and guiding reaction design. However, existing machine-learning models typically predict Mayr nucleophilicity at the whole-molecule level without identifying the experimentally relevant reaction site. Herein, we develop a P retrained and P hysicochemical feature-augmented G raph neural network model for joint N ucleophilicity and S ite prediction (PPGNS) for site-resolved Mayr N prediction. PPGNS integrates curated experimental reaction-site annotations, explicit-H molecular graphs, lightweight GFN1-xTB electronic descriptors, and reactivity-oriented pretraining incorporating methyl cation affinity. In connectivity-disjoint five-fold out-of-fold evaluation, PPGNS achieved R 2 of 0.937 and 0.950 and MAEs of 1.22 and 1.15 N units for automatic- and known-site prediction, respectively, together with 93% Top-1 and 98% Top-3 site recovery. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) identified local electronic descriptors as the dominant model attributions. PPGNS therefore enables simultaneous prediction of where nucleophilic reactivity resides and how strong it is.
items.summary_zh: 提出 PPGNS，用显式 H 分子图、GFN1-xTB 电子描述符、甲基阳离子亲和力预训练和反应位点标注，同时预测 Mayr 亲核性及其反应位点；在 connectivity-disjoint 五折 out-of-fold 评估中，自动位点预测 R² 为 0.937、MAE 为 1.22 N units，Top-1 位点恢复率为 93%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把“反应在哪个原子发生”与定量亲核性预测结合，有助于反应设计和可解释反应信息学；但训练和评估仍围绕 Mayr 体系，模型在不同反应条件、亲电试剂及前瞻合成中的适用性需继续验证。
items.abstract_zh: 亲核性是理解有机反应机制和指导反应设计的关键动力学描述符。然而，现有机器学习模型通常在整个分子层面预测 Mayr 亲核性，而不识别实验相关的反应位点。本文开发了一个用于位点解析 Mayr N 预测的、经反应性预训练并加入物理化学特征增强的图神经网络模型，用于联合亲核性和位点预测（PPGNS）。PPGNS 整合了经整理的实验反应位点标注、显式 H 分子图、轻量级 GFN1-xTB 电子描述符，以及纳入甲基阳离子亲和力的面向反应性的预训练。在 connectivity-disjoint 五折 out-of-fold 评估中，PPGNS 对自动位点预测和已知位点预测分别获得 R² 0.937 和 0.950、MAE 1.22 和 1.15 N units，同时实现 93% 的 Top-1 和 98% 的 Top-3 位点恢复率。SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）表明，局部电子描述符是模型归因的主导因素。因此，PPGNS 能够同时预测亲核反应性位于何处以及其强度。
items.author_line: Shangkun Shi, Junliang He, Zikang Dong, Zhaoyang Li, Shaoguang Zhang

items.title: PCGS: biomarker and risk group identification for Pediatric Cancers via explainable Graph neural networks with Shapley values
items.abstract_or_text: Improvements in data availability, sharing, and integration, together with the development of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques, are advancing precision medicine for pediatric cancer by facilitating diagnosis, biomarker discovery, and drug development. Data sharing commons and initiatives like the Childhood Cancer Data Initiative (CCDI) provide access to pediatric-specific genomic and clinical data cohorts and improve data availability for pediatric cancer research. Based on CCDI, a scalable AI platform, Graph Artificial Intelligence for Pediatric Oncology (GAIPO), integrates various data modalities from bulk and single-cell omics data to clinical information. Such multi-modal data facilitates the training and development of advanced XAI models for pediatric cancers. We then developed an end-to-end multi-modality framework, PCGS, for pediatric cancer by incorporating omics-specific representation learning via GNN models with cross-attention fusion and multi-objective learning for downstream tasks such as classification, clustering, and survival analysis. This framework outperforms previous supervised multi-omics integration baseline approaches based on glioma and Wilms tumor cohorts and enables GNN model explainability via Shapley value-based feature attribution approaches to explain the contributions of gene-level features across various biomedical tasks, including classification and survival. Given specific background samples (e.g., age groups, sex, grades) as baselines, this explainable GNN model estimates and ranks the importance scores for input features from each omics modality. It identifies background-specific key features for biomarker discovery, risk group identification, and survival analysis in glioma and Wilms tumor, with potential applicability to other pediatric cancers.
items.summary_zh: PCGS以图神经网络、跨注意力融合和多目标学习整合CCDI的多组学与临床资料，用Shapley值解释胶质瘤和Wilms肿瘤中的分类、聚类及生存相关特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架尝试把多模态儿科肿瘤建模与背景特异性特征归因结合；摘要未报告样本量和完整性能数值，生物标志物与风险分组仍待独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 数据可获得性、共享和整合的改善，加上可解释人工智能（XAI）技术的发展，正通过促进诊断、生物标志物发现和药物开发来推动儿科肿瘤精准医学。数据共享平台和诸如儿童癌症数据倡议（CCDI）等计划，可提供儿科特异性基因组和临床数据队列，并提高儿科肿瘤研究的数据可得性。基于CCDI，一个可扩展的AI平台——儿科肿瘤图人工智能（GAIPO）——整合了从批量和单细胞组学数据到临床信息的多种数据模态。这类多模态数据有助于为儿科肿瘤训练和开发先进XAI模型。随后，我们开发了面向儿科肿瘤的端到端多模态框架PCGS：它通过GNN模型纳入组学特异性表征学习，并结合跨注意力融合和多目标学习，用于分类、聚类和生存分析等下游任务。该框架在胶质瘤和Wilms肿瘤队列上优于既有监督式多组学整合基线方法，并通过基于Shapley值的特征归因方法实现GNN模型可解释性，以解释基因层面特征在分类和生存等多种生物医学任务中的贡献。给定特定背景样本（如年龄组、性别、分级）作为基线，这一可解释GNN模型可估计并排序每种组学模态输入特征的重要性评分。它识别了背景特异性的关键特征，用于胶质瘤和Wilms肿瘤的生物标志物发现、风险组识别和生存分析，并可能适用于其他儿科肿瘤。
items.author_line: Shi, Z., Budhkar, A., Amin, W., Pollok, K. E., Su, J., Huang, K.

items.title: IntroConformal: Conformal Factuality Guarantees for Large Vision-Language Models via Introspective Signals
items.abstract_or_text: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved strong multimodal performance, yet ensuring the factual correctness of generated content remains challenging. Existing methods that provide statistical guarantees on factuality typically rely on external verifiers or generation-time confidence signals, which introduce auxiliary dependencies or often fail for confident but incorrect outputs. We argue that reliable factuality control can instead be achieved through introspective signals derived from the model itself. We introduce IntroConformal, a training-free Conformal Risk Control (CRC) framework that provides finite-sample, distribution-free factuality guarantees. We first instantiate it with layer-wise semantic stability, a conformity score derived from hidden-state representations, and then propose verification probability, a stronger score capturing the model's self-administered judgment on claim factuality. Across multiple LVLM architectures, IntroConformal satisfies the conformal risk guarantee while substantially reducing abstention and achieving competitive or superior claim-level discrimination relative to external verifier-based baselines.
items.summary_zh: IntroConformal 是无需训练的 Conformal Risk Control 框架，利用模型层间语义稳定性或自我判断得到的 verification probability 为 LVLM 事实性提供有限样本、分布无关的风险保证。摘要称其在多种架构上满足保证，同时降低拒答率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将事实性控制表述为具有明确统计保证的选择性预测问题，且比较了内部信号与外部验证器方案；其结论限于测试的视觉语言模型和声明级评测。
items.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）已取得强大的多模态表现，但确保生成内容的事实正确性仍然具有挑战。现有提供事实性统计保证的方法通常依赖外部验证器或生成时置信度信号，这会引入辅助依赖，或者常常会在自信但错误的输出上失效。我们认为，可以通过来自模型自身的内省信号实现可靠的事实性控制。我们提出 IntroConformal，这是一个无需训练的 Conformal Risk Control（CRC）框架，提供有限样本、分布无关的事实性保证。我们首先以逐层语义稳定性来实现该框架，这是一种由隐藏状态表征导出的保形分数；随后提出 verification probability，这一更强的分数刻画模型对主张事实性的自主判断。在多种 LVLM 架构上，IntroConformal 满足保形风险保证，同时显著减少拒答，并且相较于基于外部验证器的基线，在主张级区分方面达到有竞争力或更优的表现。
items.author_line: Md. Atabuzzaman, Christian Alexander, Chris Thomas

items.title: MolLedger: An Additive Graph Neural Network with Chemically Grounded ADME Attributions
items.abstract_or_text: Optimizing absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) is an important part of small molecule drug discovery. Many machine learning models have been built to predict ADME properties to facilitate this optimization process, but explaining model predictions is challenging. We propose a new graph neural network architecture with built-in meaningful per-atom attributions. Our model MolLedger outputs predictions that are the sum of per-atom scores. MolLedger's additive framework obtains exact interpretability at no cost to performance because the global context vector gives the additive head enough context to produce good per-atom scores. Furthermore, MolLedger produces attributions that are more faithful to chemical properties than other interpretability methods because the auxiliary loss in MolLedger anchors the atom scores to chemical properties. Our case studies comparing interpretations from multiple methods on molecular pairs reveal that MolLedger is much better at producing sensible explanations for predicted property changes.
items.summary_zh: 提出 MolLedger 加性图神经网络，将 ADME 预测写为逐原子得分之和，并以辅助损失将原子贡献与化学性质关联，从模型结构中提供可解释的原子级归因。
items.why_it_matters_zh: ADME 模型若能说明性质变化由哪些原子驱动，可支持先导化合物优化中的化学判断；但目前的依据以分子对案例比较为主，尚未证明其归因能在大范围前瞻设计或湿实验中提升决策质量。
items.abstract_zh: 优化吸收、分布、代谢和排泄（ADME）是小分子药物发现的重要环节。许多机器学习模型已被构建用于预测 ADME 性质，以促进这一优化过程，但解释模型预测仍具挑战。我们提出一种新的图神经网络架构，具有内建且有意义的逐原子归因。我们的模型 MolLedger 输出的预测是逐原子得分之和。MolLedger 的加性框架在不牺牲性能的情况下获得精确可解释性，因为全局语境向量为加性头提供了足够语境，从而产生良好的逐原子得分。此外，由于 MolLedger 中的辅助损失将原子得分锚定于化学性质，MolLedger 产生的归因比其他可解释性方法更忠实于化学性质。我们对多个方法在分子对上的解释进行比较的案例研究表明，MolLedger 在为预测性质变化产生合理解释方面明显更好。
items.author_line: Christina X. Ji

items.title: Regiodivergent Biocatalytic Rearrangement of Indoles: Enantioselective Access to 2- and 3-Oxindoles Bearing Quaternary Stereocenters
items.abstract_or_text: Chiral oxindoles bearing a quaternary stereocenter are prevalent scaffolds across a wide range of biologically active natural products and pharmaceutical agents, yet their enantioselective synthesis via oxidative 1,2-shift reactions remains largely underdeveloped, particularly within the realm of biocatalysis. Herein, we report the first biocatalytic asymmetric semipinacol-type rearrangement of indoles with C–C bond migration, mediated by engineered flavin-dependent styrene monooxygenases (StyAs), enabling the enantioselective synthesis of both 3,3-dialkyl-substituted 2-oxindoles and 2,2-dialkyl-substituted 3-oxindoles. Screening of an extensive library of flavin-dependent monooxygenases, comprising wild-type StyAs, Pseudomonas StyA variants and Baeyer-Villiger monooxygenases, against a pyrano-[2,3]-fused indole model substrate identified the double mutant PsStyA-Q4 (V48N/Y73V) as the optimal biocatalyst, delivering the (R)-configured spiro-2-oxindole with up to full conversion and excellent enantioselectivity (>99% ee) under mild aqueous conditions. Substrate scope evaluation confirmed broad generality across methyl- and halogen-substituted indoles, while a set of 3-allyl- and 3-benzyl-substituted indoles, converted by PsStyA-Q4 or wild-type SwStyA, gave access to the complementary 2,2-dialkyl-3-oxindole scaffold with equally excellent enantiocontrol. Quantum chemical calculations suggest that both substrate classes share the same intrinsic migratory preference, so that the exclusive formation of spiro-2oxindoles from the pyrano-fused indoles cannot be traced back to substrate control alone. These observations indicate that the styrene monooxygenases exert control not merely over the initial oxygen transfer, but throughout the rearrangement itself.
items.summary_zh: 报道工程化黄素依赖型苯乙烯单加氧酶（StyAs）催化吲哚的不对称半频哪醇型重排，实现带季碳立体中心的 2-与 3-oxindoles 的区域分歧合成；PsStyA-Q4（V48N/Y73V）对代表性底物达到完全转化和 >99% ee。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作以酶工程、底物范围和量子化学计算相结合，扩展了手性 oxindole 骨架的温和水相合成；但仍是预印本，反应放大、酶稳定性及面向药物合成的普适性有待独立复现。
items.abstract_zh: 带有季碳立体中心的手性 oxindoles 是广泛生物活性天然产物和药物制剂中的常见骨架，但通过氧化 1,2-迁移反应实现其对映选择性合成仍很不充分，尤其在生物催化领域。本文报道了首个由工程化黄素依赖型苯乙烯单加氧酶（StyAs）介导、伴随 C–C 键迁移的吲哚生物催化不对称半频哪醇型重排，可对映选择性合成 3,3-二烷基取代 2-oxindoles 和 2,2-二烷基取代 3-oxindoles。针对一个 pyrano-[2,3]-稠合吲哚模型底物，对包含野生型 StyAs、Pseudomonas StyA 变体和 Baeyer-Villiger monooxygenases 的大型黄素依赖型单加氧酶文库进行筛选，确定双突变体 PsStyA-Q4（V48N/Y73V）为最优生物催化剂；在温和水相条件下，它可生成（R）构型螺环-2-oxindole，转化率最高可达完全转化，且对映选择性优异（>99% ee）。底物范围评估证实，其对甲基和卤素取代吲哚具有广泛普适性；同时，一组 3-allyl 和 3-benzyl 取代吲哚在 PsStyA-Q4 或野生型 SwStyA 转化下，可获得互补的 2,2-二烷基-3-oxindole 骨架，且同样具有优异的对映控制。量子化学计算表明，两类底物具有相同的内在迁移偏好，因此 pyrano-稠合吲哚专一形成螺环-2-oxindoles 不能只归因于底物控制。这些观察表明，苯乙烯单加氧酶不仅控制初始氧转移，而且在整个重排过程中发挥控制作用。
items.author_line: Jingyi Li, Jingsong Song, Jan Deska, J. D. Rolfes, Jinhui Feng, Xuejie Qi, Yuchang Liu, Qiaqing Wu, Dunming Zhu

items.title: AdaptNTK: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification and Active Learning for Neural Network Potentials
items.abstract_or_text: Machine learning interatomic potentials bridge the gap between quantum chemical precision and classical computational speed, enabling molecular dynamics simulations with first-principles accuracy. Their reliability is often improved through active learning, which iteratively expands the training set by identifying uncertain, out-of-distribution configurations. Existing uncertainty-quantification methods often involve a trade-off between computational cost and reliability, and generally cannot account for redundancy as an acquisition batch is assembled. Here, we introduce AdaptNTK, a single-model framework that measures uncertainty as a regularized Mahalanobis distance in empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) feature space. With the NTK features fixed during acquisition, the uncertainty depends on the acquired configurations but not their reference labels. This allows the uncertainty to be updated recursively after each selection without retraining, reducing redundancy within an acquisition batch. On held-out rMD17 data, AdaptNTK achieves the highest mean correlations with force errors (Spearman 0.68, Pearson 0.71) and matches a three-member ensemble in error retention. In active learning experiments, AdaptNTK achieves the lowest force errors across rMD17 and Transition-1X, with particularly strong performance on transition-state configurations in Transition-1X. AdaptNTK provides a 2.6-fold speedup per Transition-1X cycle relative to the ensemble, providing efficient single-model uncertainty estimation with sequential updates for data-efficient active learning.
items.summary_zh: 提出 AdaptNTK 单模型不确定性量化与主动学习框架：以经验 neural tangent kernel 特征空间中的正则化 Mahalanobis 距离度量不确定性，采集时无需重训练即可逐项更新，减少同批构型冗余。其在 rMD17 和 Transition-1X 上报告更低力误差，并在 Transition-1X 循环中较三成员 ensemble 快 2.6 倍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 高效识别神经网络势的外推风险是把机器学习势用于反应和材料模拟的核心问题；不过评估集中于两个计算基准，针对更复杂凝聚态体系和真实工作流的泛化仍需要验证。
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势在量子化学精度与经典计算速度之间架起桥梁，使具有第一性原理精度的分子动力学模拟成为可能。其可靠性通常通过主动学习提高：主动学习通过识别不确定的、分布外构型，迭代扩展训练集。现有不确定性量化方法常在计算成本和可靠性之间权衡，并且通常无法在组装采集批次时考虑冗余。本文引入 AdaptNTK，一个单模型框架，它将不确定性度量为经验神经切线核（NTK）特征空间中的正则化 Mahalanobis 距离。在采集期间 NTK 特征保持固定，因此不确定性依赖于已采集构型而不依赖其参考标签。这使得不确定性可在每次选择后递归更新而无需重新训练，从而减少采集批次内的冗余。在留出的 rMD17 数据上，AdaptNTK 与力误差达到最高平均相关性（Spearman 0.68，Pearson 0.71），并在误差保留方面与 3 成员 ensemble 相当。在主动学习实验中，AdaptNTK 在 rMD17 和 Transition-1X 上取得最低力误差，尤其在 Transition-1X 的过渡态构型上表现强劲。与 ensemble 相比，AdaptNTK 在每个 Transition-1X 循环中实现 2.6 倍加速，提供了具有序贯更新能力、可实现数据高效主动学习的单模型不确定性估计。
items.author_line: Prajwal Ananth, Shuwen Yue

items.title: Coarse composition suffices: tabular in-context learning for multi-activity antimicrobial peptide profiling
items.abstract_or_text: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) often act against multiple pathogen classes, making multi-label activity prediction a more realistic screening target than binary antimicrobial classification. The ESCAPE benchmark formalizes this setting, but leading approaches typically rely on multimodal, structure-conditioned deep models that are costly to train and tune. We show that a simple, sequence-only pipeline can match and surpass these methods by combining 330 interpretable sequence descriptors with TabPFN, a tabular foundation model that performs in-context prediction in a single forward pass without gradient-based training or hyperparameter search. On ESCAPE (82,359 peptides; five labels), a label-powerset TabPFN model achieves mAP-5 = 77.8%, improving on the previously best reported 72.1%. A probabilistic classifier chain is the first method to match or exceed the best published average precision on each of the five labels simultaneously. The gains persist under the prior state-of-the-art single-fold training protocol, indicating they are not a training-set-size artefact, and are largest for remote homologues (+11.2 points below 30% sequence identity). Ablations further show that predicted structure is unnecessary at inference and that performance is not driven by any single descriptor family: ten global physicochemical scalars recover 91% of full-feature performance. Finally, explicitly modelling label dependence yields targeted benefits for scarce activities and supports ranking which activity to assay next from partial positive evidence.
items.summary_zh: 以 330 个可解释序列描述符和表格基础模型 TabPFN，构建无需梯度训练或超参数搜索的抗菌肽多标签活性预测流程；在 ESCAPE 的 82,359 条肽、5 个标签上，label-powerset TabPFN 获得 mAP-5 = 77.8%，高于此前的 72.1%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果表明简单的序列特征与表格基础模型可在远同源肽上超过昂贵的结构条件模型，并为多活性筛选提供可解释基线；但性能来自既有基准，模型对新测定体系、毒性和体内药代性质的预测仍未验证。
items.abstract_zh: 抗菌肽（AMPs）通常对多类病原体发挥作用，因此多标签活性预测比二元抗菌分类更符合实际筛选目标。ESCAPE 基准将这一场景形式化，但领先方法通常依赖多模态、结构条件深度模型，训练和调参成本高昂。我们表明，一个简单的仅序列流程可通过结合 330 个可解释序列描述符和 TabPFN——一种表格基础模型，可在单次前向传播中执行上下文预测，无需基于梯度的训练或超参数搜索——达到并超过这些方法。在 ESCAPE（82,359 条肽；5 个标签）上，label-powerset TabPFN 模型取得 mAP-5 = 77.8%，优于此前报道的最佳值 72.1%。概率分类器链首次在所有 5 个标签上同时达到或超过已发表的最佳平均精度。该增益在此前最先进的单折训练协议下仍然存在，表明它并非训练集规模造成的假象；对于远同源序列，其增益最大（序列一致性低于 30% 时提高 +11.2 个百分点）。消融实验进一步表明，推理时不需要预测结构，而且性能并非由某一类描述符单独驱动：10 个全局理化标量可恢复完整特征性能的 91%。最后，显式建模标签依赖性可为稀缺活性带来有针对性的收益，并支持依据部分阳性证据对下一项应检测的活性进行排序。
items.author_line: Raunak Kumar, Anuj Pal, Dhruvi Solanki, Parikshit Pareek, Juhi Singh, Jitin Singla

items.title: Novel Large Language Model-Based Detection of Echocardiographic Markers of Right Ventricular Dysfunction
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Unstructured biomedical data, such as echocardiography reports, are rich in information but time consuming to analyze at scale. Rule-based, regular expression-driven terminology mapping can only extract individual variables while large language models (LLMs) offer scalable and clinically meaningful interpretations of heterogeneous disease processes. Right ventricular dysfunction (RVD) is an example of a multifactorial disease state in which key structural and physiologic features are captured both narratively and in structured fields, making it an ideal test case for evaluating whether LLMs can recover complex phenotypes that rules based methods routinely miss. Purpose: To compare an LLM-based extraction method to a conventional rules-based schema for identifying and phenotyping echocardiographic features associated with RVD in a large TTE dataset. Methods: MIMIC-III NOTE2NUM echocardiography reports (n = 45,794) were analyzed using GPT-4o-based LLM extraction deployed within a secure health system enclave and were benchmarked against echocardiographic measurements defined in the MIMIC-III dictionary schema. In MIMIC-III, PH was recorded qualitatively (mild/moderate/severe) based on tricuspid regurgitant (TR) jet velocity and then re-coded as present vs. absent. LLM based extraction defined RVD as (1) RV structural abnormality (>= 1 of hypertrophy, dilation, or wall hypo-/akinesis) or (2) RV pressure/volume overload (>= 2 of the following: estimated right atrial pressure > 8 mmHg, TR jet velocity > 2.8 m/s, fractional area change 14), with PH defined as estimated pulmonary artery systolic pressure > 35 mmHg or qualitative documentation of PH. Results: LLM extraction identified PH in 15,394 (33.6%), RV pressure/volume overload in 14,449 (31.6%), and RV structural abnormalities in 11,955 (26.1%). Co-occurrence was common: overload + structural changes in 9,380 (20.5%), overload + PH in 9,756 (21.3%), structural changes + PH in 6,183 (13.5%), and all three in 5,620 (12.3%). Using the MIMIC-III dictionary schema, PH prevalence was similar (15,371; 33.6%), but RV overload fields were captured less often (pressure overload 1,357 [3.0%], volume overload 1,128 [2.5%], pressure + volume overload 1,093 [2.4%]; any overload field 3,578 [7.8%]), and RV pressure/volume overload with PH was identified in only 731 (1.6%). Conclusions: LLM-based extraction outperforms rules-based schemas for identifying complex disease states not defined by any single variable. By synthesizing multifactorial signals, LLMs can phenotype RVD with higher fidelity and support population-level assessment. Further validation using multimodality imaging, invasive hemodynamics, and clinical outcome data is needed.
items.summary_zh: 研究在45,794份MIMIC-III NOTE2NUM超声心动图报告上比较GPT-4o提取与规则字段，显示LLM可识别更多右心室压力/容量负荷表型；尚缺乏影像、血流动力学或结局金标准验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大样本非结构化临床文本分析展示了LLM表型提取的覆盖优势，同时作者明确指出仍需以独立临床证据验证其准确性。
items.abstract_zh: 超声心动图报告等非结构化生物医学数据富含信息，却难以大规模分析。基于规则、由正则表达式驱动的术语映射只能提取单个变量，而大语言模型（LLMs）可对异质疾病过程提供可扩展且具有临床意义的解释。右心室功能障碍（RVD）是一个多因素疾病状态的例子，其关键结构和生理特征同时以叙述性和结构化字段记录，因此适合用于评估LLMs能否恢复基于规则的方法常常遗漏的复杂表型。目的：比较基于LLM的提取方法与传统规则式模式在大型经胸超声心动图（TTE）数据集中识别和表型化RVD相关超声特征的能力。方法：在安全的卫生系统隔离环境中部署基于GPT-4o的LLM提取，对MIMIC-III NOTE2NUM的45,794份超声心动图报告进行分析，并以MIMIC-III字典模式所定义的超声测量指标为基准。在MIMIC-III中，肺动脉高压（PH）基于三尖瓣反流（TR）射流速度以轻度/中度/重度定性记录，随后重编码为存在与否。LLM提取将RVD定义为：（1）右心室结构异常（肥厚、扩张或室壁运动减弱/无运动中至少1项），或（2）右心室压力/容量负荷（以下至少2项：估计右心房压>8 mmHg、TR射流速度>2.8 m/s、面积变化率 35 mmHg或有PH的定性记录。结果：LLM提取识别出15,394例（33.6%）PH、14,449例（31.6%）右心室压力/容量负荷和11,955例（26.1%）右心室结构异常。共现较常见：负荷加结构改变9,380例（20.5%）、负荷加PH 9,756例（21.3%）、结构改变加PH 6,183例（13.5%），三者均有5,620例（12.3%）。采用MIMIC-III字典模式时，PH患病率相似（15,371例；33.6%），但右心室负荷字段捕获较少（压力负荷1,357例，3.0%；容量负荷1,128例，2.5%；压力加容量负荷1,093例，2.4%；任意负荷字段3,578例，7.8%），且仅731例（1.6%）被识别为右心室压力/容量负荷伴PH。结论：基于LLM的提取在识别不能由任何单一变量定义的复杂疾病状态方面优于规则式模式。通过综合多因素信号，LLMs能够以更高保真度对RVD进行表型化，并支持人群水平评估。仍需使用多模态影像、侵入性血流动力学和临床结局数据进行进一步验证。
items.author_line: Ekambarapu L, Pendyal A, Lin A, Alwakeel M, Rajaratnam A

items.title: Dense Clinical Contrasts Enhance Medical Knowledge Updating in Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Medical knowledge changes continually, making large language models vulnerable to relying on outdated yet clinically plausible information. We study whether the format of supervision affects medical knowledge updating under a matched training-budget setting. We introduce SEER-Bench, a temporally anchored oncology-staging benchmark curated from the latest versioned SEER Research Data release, and render identical medical update events from NCCN oncology guidelines into four supervision formats: EMQ, MSQ, FITB, and SAQ. Across SEER-Bench and HealthBench Professional, EMQ gives the most stable external transfer and retention among same-budget SFT variants. With EMQ supervision, the updated 4B model produces competitive results on temporally anchored oncology staging, reaching 64.8% answer accuracy and 59.6% rationale accuracy on SEER-Bench. Diagnostic analyses suggest that EMQ exposes denser clinical contrast signals while preserving discriminative representations with smaller movement from the base model. These results show that medical knowledge updating depends not only on the update algorithm, but also on how knowledge is structured as supervision.
items.summary_zh: SEER-Bench以时间版本锚定的肿瘤分期事件，比较4种等训练预算的医疗知识更新监督格式；EMQ在外部迁移和保留上最稳定。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作强调医疗LLM知识更新的监督组织形式本身会影响更新质量，并通过时间锚定基准减少“旧知识仍合理”的评测混淆。
items.abstract_zh: 医疗知识持续变化，使大语言模型容易依赖过时但临床上看似合理的信息。我们研究在匹配训练预算条件下，监督格式是否影响医疗知识更新。我们引入SEER-Bench：一个基于最新版本SEER Research Data发布内容整理、以时间为基准的肿瘤分期基准；并将来自NCCN肿瘤学指南的相同医疗更新事件渲染为四种监督格式：EMQ、MSQ、FITB和SAQ。在SEER-Bench和HealthBench Professional上，EMQ在相同预算的监督微调（SFT）变体中展现出最稳定的外部迁移与保留能力。使用EMQ监督后，更新的4B模型在时间锚定肿瘤分期上取得有竞争力的结果，在SEER-Bench上的答案准确率达到64.8%，推理依据准确率达到59.6%。诊断性分析表明，EMQ暴露出更密集的临床对比信号，并以相较基础模型更小的表征移动保留判别性表征。这些结果表明，医疗知识更新不仅取决于更新算法，也取决于知识如何被组织为监督信号。
items.author_line: Yangmin Huang, Shu Quan, He Geng, Xin Ye, Qianyun Du, Zhiyang He, Jiaxue Hu, Xiaodong Tao

items.title: Autoregressive Mosaics: Probing 2D Spatial Reasoning in Text-Only Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) trained only on text and code can sometimes generate programs that draw recognizable images. However, it is unclear whether this reflects an internal representation of 2D spatial layout or simply the ability to translate spatial descriptions into code. We introduce Autoregressive Mosaics (AM-Bench), a benchmark that separates these factors: First, a translation task gives a model a fully specified geometry of a picture in words as a prompt and asks for the code that produces it. Second, a layout task requires the model to compose an image from an underspecified prompt. Across eight open-weight text-and-code-only models, all models reliably translate specified geometry into code, but their open-ended layout performance differs substantially, indicating that these differences are not explained by code-generation ability alone. An output-medium ablation further shows that the interface or medium of expression that the model uses matters: replacing procedural code with raw SVG improves layout scores across all models. Finally, probing model activations shows that a coarse layout plan is present before generation, but reflects only the layout implied by the prompt. During generation, models track the evolving geometric state instead of executing an initially fixed plan. Overall, these results show that 2D spatial performance in text-only LLMs depends on both the model and the output medium, and is not explained by code-generation ability alone.
items.summary_zh: AM-Bench 将“按完整几何描述生成代码”与“由不充分提示完成布局”分开评测，发现文本与代码模型在前一任务上较稳定，开放式二维布局能力却差异显著；以 SVG 代替过程式代码还能普遍提高布局分数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提示代码生成成功并不能单独证明模型具有稳健的空间表征，并用任务拆分、输出媒介消融和激活探查提供了可检验的分析。
items.abstract_zh: 仅在文本和代码上训练的大语言模型（LLMs）有时能够生成绘制出可辨识图像的程序。然而，目前尚不清楚这反映了其内部的二维空间布局表征，还是仅仅反映了将空间描述转换为代码的能力。我们提出 Autoregressive Mosaics（AM-Bench），这是一个用于区分这两种因素的基准：第一项翻译任务在提示中以文字给出图像完全指定的几何信息，并要求模型生成绘制该图像的代码。第二项布局任务则要求模型根据一个信息不充分的提示组合出一幅图像。在八个仅以文本和代码训练的开放权重模型中，所有模型都能可靠地将指定几何信息翻译为代码，但其开放式布局表现差异很大，表明这些差异不能仅由代码生成能力解释。进一步的输出媒介消融表明，模型使用的表达接口或媒介也会产生影响：以原始 SVG 替换过程式代码会提高所有模型的布局分数。最后，对模型激活的探查显示，生成前已有一个粗略的布局计划，但它只反映提示所蕴含的布局。生成过程中，模型会跟踪不断演化的几何状态，而非执行一个预先固定的计划。总体而言，这些结果表明，仅文本 LLM 的二维空间表现同时取决于模型和输出媒介，且不能仅由代码生成能力解释。
items.author_line: Ashwin Nedungadi, Stefan Oehmcke, Stefan Lüdtke

items.title: Do General NLP Embeddings Capture Ontological Reasoning?
items.abstract_or_text: General-purpose NLP embedding models perform well on linguistic tasks, but their ability to capture symbolic ontological structure remains unclear. We introduce AVA, a systematic framework for evaluating whether embeddings distinguish logic-sensitive relational semantics in ontologies and knowledge graphs. AVA comprises 171,007 contrastive triplets derived from 163 heterogeneous ontologies using hierarchy inversion, relation substitution, and disjointness injection. Each triplet contains an ontology statement, a semantically equivalent paraphrase, and a logic-sensitive hard negative with contradictory relational meaning. We evaluate more than 25 state-of-the-art embedding models and find substantial limitations: the best model achieves only 0.739 triplet accuracy, while hard negative accuracy falls to 0.135. Fine-tuning improves discrimination by a large margin but transfers poorly to downstream Semantic Web tasks, including taxonomy discovery and ontology alignment. Further analysis suggests that improvements stem partly from perturbation-specific pattern recognition rather than robust ontological understanding. These findings reveal a persistent gap between linguistic representation learning and ontology-level discrimination, challenging the assumption that strong NLP benchmark performance translates to Semantic Web competence.
items.summary_zh: AVA 从 163 个异构本体构造 171,007 个对比三元组，以层级反转、关系替换和不相交注入测试嵌入模型能否区分逻辑敏感的关系语义。超过 25 个模型的测试显示，最佳三元组准确率仅为 0.739，困难负例准确率降至 0.135。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该评测以逻辑矛盾的困难负例检验表示模型，而非仅以语言相似度判断；结果也显示微调后的提升未稳定迁移到本体发现和对齐等下游任务。
items.abstract_zh: 通用 NLP 嵌入模型在语言任务上表现良好，但其捕捉符号化本体结构的能力仍不清楚。我们提出 AVA，这是一个系统框架，用于评估嵌入是否能区分本体和知识图谱中对逻辑敏感的关系语义。AVA 包含从 163 个异构本体中通过层级反转、关系替换和不相交注入构建的 171,007 个对比三元组。每个三元组包含一条本体陈述、一个语义等价的改述，以及一个具有矛盾关系含义的逻辑敏感困难负例。我们评估了超过 25 个最先进的嵌入模型，发现存在显著局限：最佳模型的三元组准确率仅为 0.739，而困难负例准确率降至 0.135。微调大幅提升了区分能力，但向包括分类体系发现和本体对齐在内的下游语义网任务迁移时表现较差。进一步分析表明，改进部分源于针对扰动的模式识别，而非稳健的本体理解。这些发现揭示了语言表征学习与本体层面区分之间持续存在的差距，挑战了强大的 NLP 基准表现能够转化为语义网能力这一假设。

items.abstract_zh: 今天我们推出 BenchMIRT：一种在单条提示层级审计 LLM 基准的新方法，这些提示是模型得分所依据的问题和任务。基准通常旨在测量某种特定能力，如安全性、通用推理或指令遵循，但其中的单项任务可能依赖于该既定目标之外的能力。BenchMIRT 通过分析模型在每个问题或任务上的表现，并估计哪些潜在能力与答对问题关系最密切，帮助研究者分离这些信号，了解真正驱动基准分数的因素。

items.title: Unveiling Phase Transformation Mechanism in BN from Large-Scale Machine Learning Molecular Dynamics
items.abstract_or_text: BN-based materials in modern electronics, quantum photonics, and energy devices. Despite their technological importance, the atomistic mechanisms underlying its phase evolution remain poorly understood. Here, we use large-scale molecular dynamics simulations with a MACE-based machine-learning interatomic potential to investigate phase-transformation pathways in crystalline BN. Trained on high-fidelity density functional theory (DFT) data and validated against ab initio molecular dynamics simulations, the potential enables simulations of phase evolution across extended length and time scales. We identify a layer-by-layer transformation mechanism that initiates at interfaces, where lattice mismatch and local structural disorder promote reconstructive transformations. We further show that transformation propensity depends non-monotonically on interfacial energy and is enhanced by compressive stresses generated during thermal treatment. These results provide atomistic insight into BN phase transformations under diverse thermodynamic conditions, while the associated MACE training workflow offers a generalizable framework for studying phase-transformation mechanisms in other complex materials.
items.summary_zh: 利用基于 MACE 的机器学习原子间势进行大规模分子动力学模拟，结合 DFT 训练和 ab initio 分子动力学验证，解析晶态 BN 的界面起始、逐层相变机制及界面能和热处理压应力的作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了机器学习势如何延伸 DFT 可覆盖的时间和长度尺度，以研究 BN 相变；但结论主要来自计算模拟，仍需原位结构表征验证相变路径与应力效应。
items.abstract_zh: BN 基材料用于现代电子学、量子光子学和能源器件。尽管具有重要技术意义，其相演化的原子尺度机制仍知之甚少。本文使用带有基于 MACE 的机器学习原子间势的大规模分子动力学模拟，研究晶态 BN 中的相变路径。该势在高保真密度泛函理论（DFT）数据上训练，并针对 ab initio 分子动力学模拟进行了验证，因此能够在更长的长度和时间尺度上模拟相演化。我们识别出一种逐层相变机制，该机制始于界面，在那里晶格失配和局部结构无序促进了重构型转变。我们进一步表明，相变倾向对界面能呈非单调依赖，并受到热处理期间产生的压应力增强。这些结果为不同热力学条件下 BN 相变提供了原子尺度见解，而相关的 MACE 训练流程则为研究其他复杂材料中的相变机制提供了可泛化框架。
items.author_line: Jaeyoung Cho, Nikhil Rampal, Stephen E. Weitzner, Graeme Henkelman, Liwen F. Wan

items.title: From Surface to Bulk and Back: Dynamic Redistribution of Iron in CeO2(111) Model Catalysts under Reducing and Oxidizing Conditions
items.abstract_or_text: Transition-metal modification of cerium dioxide (CeO2) is widely employed to enhance catalytic performance through the creation of active sites, promotion of oxygen-vacancy formation, and improved oxygen mobility. All of these effects can be strongly influenced by the dynamic redistribution of dopant species under reaction conditions, a phenomenon that remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the redox-dependent redistributing of Fe in a well-defined FeOx/CeO2(111) model systems using scanning tunneling microscopy, near-ambient pressure X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, low-energy electron diffraction, and ion sputtering depth profiling by introducing ultra-high vacuum conditions and reducing (H2) or oxidizing (O2) environments at temperatures up to 850 K. Under reducing conditions, the FeOx overlayer becomes unstable above 600–750 K and undergoes extensive disintegration accompanied by Fe diffusion into the CeO2 bulk. Depth profiling reveals a non-uniform Fe distribution with preferential accumulation in deeper regions of the ceria film, eventually approaching the CeO2(111)/ Pt(111) interface. In contrast, oxidizing conditions stabilize Fe at the CeO2(111) surface over the entire investigated temperature range accompanied by substantial restructuring of FeOx species on the surface. Fe incorporation is shown to be reversible, as oxygen annealing of samples with Fe-depleted surfaces restores Fe to the surface. These results demonstrate that FeOx/CeO2(111) systems exhibit fundamentally different structural and chemical behavior under reducing and oxidizing environments, enabling a dynamic redistribution of Fe. The observed activation temperatures for Fe redistribution closely coincide with those reported for Fe–CeO2 catalyst activation in hydrogen temperature-programmed reduction experiments, suggesting that redox-controlled Fe redistribution represent a key structural process governing the performance of Fe-containing ceria catalysts.
items.summary_zh: 以 STM、近环境压 XPS、LEED 和离子溅射深度剖析研究 FeOx/CeO2(111) 模型催化剂，发现还原条件下 Fe 在 600–750 K 以上向 CeO2 体相扩散，而氧化条件下 Fe 保持于表面且氧退火可使其再偏析至表面。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 直接揭示氧化还原环境可逆调控 Fe–CeO2 活性结构，为理解含铁氧化铈催化剂活化提供结构依据；但模型薄膜体系与负载型实际催化剂存在差异，尚未同步测量催化反应性能。
items.abstract_zh: 过渡金属修饰二氧化铈（CeO2）被广泛用于通过形成活性位点、促进氧空位形成和改善氧迁移率来提升催化性能。所有这些效应都可能强烈受反应条件下掺杂物种动态再分布的影响，而这一现象仍缺乏深入认识。本文通过在超高真空条件以及最高 850 K 的还原（H2）或氧化（O2）环境下，使用扫描隧道显微镜、近环境压 X 射线光电子能谱、低能电子衍射和离子溅射深度剖析，研究了明确限定的 FeOx/CeO2(111) 模型体系中 Fe 的氧化还原依赖性再分布。在还原条件下，FeOx 覆层在 600–750 K 以上变得不稳定并发生广泛解体，同时 Fe 向 CeO2 体相扩散。深度剖析显示 Fe 分布不均匀，并优先积累于铈膜较深区域，最终接近 CeO2(111)/Pt(111) 界面。相反，氧化条件在全部考察温度范围内稳定了 CeO2(111) 表面的 Fe，同时伴随表面 FeOx 物种的大幅重构。已证明 Fe 掺入是可逆的：对表面 Fe 耗竭样品进行氧气退火可使 Fe 恢复至表面。这些结果表明，FeOx/CeO2(111) 体系在还原和氧化环境下表现出根本不同的结构和化学行为，从而实现 Fe 的动态再分布。观察到的 Fe 再分布活化温度与氢气程序升温还原实验中报道的 Fe–CeO2 催化剂活化温度密切一致，表明氧化还原控制的 Fe 再分布可能是支配含 Fe 氧化铈催化剂性能的关键结构过程。

items.title: BanffNET, a Deep Learning System for Comprehensive Histological Lesion Quantification in Kidney Transplant Biopsies
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate, reproducible interpretation of kidney allograft biopsies is critical for diagnosis of graft injury to guide prognosis and management. The international Banff classification is a consensus diagnostic system based on semiquantitative histological lesion scoring on either extent or severity of kidney transplant biopsies. However, pathologist scoring is limited by substantial interobserver variability, constrained scalability, and the inherent nature of the scoring system itself. Here we present BanffNET, a weakly supervised, probabilistic deep learning framework that combines self-supervised feature extraction with a novel Bayesian multiple-instance learning framework to predict (continuously) the full spectrum of Banff lesion scores directly from whole-slide images (WSIs). Using lesion-specific aggregation functions tailored to localized (modeling lesion severity) and diffuse pathologies (modeling lesion extent), BanffNET generates interpretable, patch-level probability maps and calibrated slide-level scores. BanffNET's performance was assessed relative to consensus, biological correlates of rejection and clinical outcome, demonstrating superior consistency, transportability and generalization. Trained on 7,249 WSIs from three cohorts, BanffNET demonstrates consistent performance on 11,028 WSIs across five external test sets, performing on par or exceeding expert consensus across lesions. BanffNET scores align more closely than pathologist Banff scores with molecular profiles of rejection, offering a transparent, biologically grounded framework for computational pathology with relevance beyond transplantation.

items.title: Agentic programs: an emerging form of scientific software in computational materials science
items.abstract_or_text: Computational materials science has traditionally delegated algorithmic tasks to computers while leaving scientific judgments to humans. We argue that recent LLM-based agent harnesses enable an emerging form of scientific software, agentic programs, that combine deterministic algorithms with bounded LLM-based judgment, task-specific verification, episodic maturation, and complete delegation in production. We illustrate this concept with DeMARS, an agentic program for constructing atomistic models from experimentally measured disordered crystal structures.
items.summary_zh: 提出“agentic programs”作为计算材料科学中一类新兴科学软件：将确定性算法与受限 LLM 判断、任务特异验证、阶段性成熟和生产环境的完整委托结合，并以 DeMARS 从实验测得的无序晶体结构构建原子模型为例说明。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 文章将 AI 代理的科学判断、验证和可运行软件放在同一框架讨论，对材料计算工作流设计具有启发性；但摘要仅给出概念和一个示例，未提供与既有软件或人工流程的定量比较。
items.abstract_zh: 计算材料科学传统上将算法任务交给计算机，同时将科学判断留给人类。我们认为，近期基于 LLM 的 agent harnesses 使一种新兴科学软件形式成为可能，即 agentic programs；它们将确定性算法与受限的基于 LLM 的判断、任务特异验证、阶段性成熟以及生产环境中的完整委托相结合。我们以 DeMARS 说明这一概念：它是一个 agentic program，用于从实验测得的无序晶体结构构建原子模型。

items.title: A lipid-laden macrophage niche drives immunosuppression in primary central nervous system lymphoma
items.abstract_or_text: Primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL) is histologically a subtype of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), sharing genetic and transcriptomic similarity, but with distinct clinical features, particularly its confinement to the CNS and higher relapse risk. The microenvironmental basis for its divergence from systemic DLBCL remains unclear. Using spatial transcriptomic approaches (Xenium/GeoMx digital spatial profiling) in a comparative study of PCNSL (n=17) and DLBCL (n=76), we found that PCNSL, unlike systemic DLBCL, is dominated by an immunosuppressive macrophage compartment enriched for cholesterol-metabolism programs. In independent cohorts of PCNSL profiled by single-cell RNA sequencing, we validated the presence of a recurrent population of lipid-laden macrophages (LLMs): TREM2/GPNMB-expressing, lipid-remodeled cells transcriptionally distinct from resident microglia and consistent with an infiltrating monocyte origin, not previously characterized in CNS lymphoma. LLMs formed immunosuppressive niches with regulatory T cells, and using Cellscape hyperplex proteomic imaging we demonstrate that LLM-Treg spatial interactions are associated with chemotherapy response. To test whether LLMs are lymphoma-driven and functionally important, we developed an immunocompetent syngeneic PCNSL mouse model, driven by Myd88L252P and Cd79b mutations with Bcl2 overexpression. Monocyte-derived macrophages in lymphoma-bearing brain regions acquired an LLM-like state, not seen in lymphoma-free brain regions or in splenic tumors driven by the same oncogenic lesions. TREM2-SYK signaling sustained this state, and SYK inhibition reversed its tumor-supportive activity ex vivo. These findings identify the LLM program as a targetable immunosuppressive myeloid state in CNS lymphoma.
items.summary_zh: 研究以空间转录组、单细胞RNA测序、空间蛋白组和免疫完整小鼠模型，描述PCNSL中TREM2/GPNMB阳性脂质负荷巨噬细胞及其与Treg形成的免疫抑制微环境。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 人类队列与功能模型相互支持，提示TREM2-SYK轴值得进一步作为PCNSL免疫微环境干预靶点研究；SYK抑制的证据目前限于ex vivo。
items.abstract_zh: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤（PCNSL）在组织学上属于弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）的一个亚型，与之共享遗传和转录组相似性，却具有不同的临床特征，尤其是局限于中枢神经系统以及更高的复发风险。其与系统性DLBCL分化的微环境基础尚不明确。我们在PCNSL（n=17）与DLBCL（n=76）的比较研究中采用空间转录组方法（Xenium/GeoMx数字空间分析），发现与系统性DLBCL不同，PCNSL由富集胆固醇代谢程序的免疫抑制性巨噬细胞区室主导。在经单细胞RNA测序分析的独立PCNSL队列中，我们验证了脂质负荷巨噬细胞（LLMs）这一反复出现的群体：这些表达TREM2/GPNMB、发生脂质重塑的细胞在转录上不同于驻留小胶质细胞，并与浸润性单核细胞来源一致，此前尚未在中枢神经系统淋巴瘤中得到表征。LLMs与调节性T细胞形成免疫抑制性微环境；借助Cellscape超多重蛋白组学成像，我们表明LLM-Treg空间相互作用与化疗反应相关。为检验LLMs是否由淋巴瘤驱动且具有功能重要性，我们建立了免疫完整的同系PCNSL小鼠模型，由Myd88L252P和Cd79b突变并伴随Bcl2过表达驱动。携瘤脑区的单核细胞来源巨噬细胞获得LLM样状态，而无淋巴瘤脑区及由相同致癌病变驱动的脾脏肿瘤中未出现该状态。TREM2-SYK信号维持这一状态，SYK抑制在ex vivo条件下逆转了其支持肿瘤的活性。这些发现将LLM程序确定为中枢神经系统淋巴瘤中可靶向的免疫抑制性髓系细胞状态。

items.title: Scaling recipes for single-cell RNA sequencing foundation models: when do scaling laws hold?
items.abstract_or_text: Deep learning models exhibit empirical scaling laws whereby performance changes predictably with model size, dataset size, and training compute. Although these relationships are well established in domains such as language and image modelling, their applicability to biological data remains unclear. Here, we investigate scaling behaviour in foundation models trained on large collec tions of single-cell transcriptomes. We show that pre-training loss decreases systematically with model capacity and training compute, exhibiting a power law dependence on model size. The strength and regularity of these trends differ between model formulations. We identify and quantify empirical relationships linking the optimal learning rate and depth-to-width ratio to model size and depth or compute. These results demonstrate that scaling principles extend to transcriptomic modelling. More broadly, they provide a quantitative framework for estimating the expected returns from additional resources and selecting suit able hyperparameters and architectures, thereby supporting the development of increasingly capable foundation models for omics data.
items.summary_zh: 研究量化单细胞转录组基础模型的模型容量、训练算力与预训练损失关系，并给出学习率和深宽比随模型规模或算力变化的经验关系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若这些规律能在更多任务和数据上复现，可帮助组学基础模型在训练资源配置与架构选择中作出更可量化的决策。
evidence_flags: 大规模单细胞转录组集合
items.abstract_zh: 深度学习模型呈现经验缩放定律，其性能随模型规模、数据集规模和训练算力以可预测方式变化。尽管这类关系已在语言和图像建模等领域得到充分确立，它们是否适用于生物数据尚不明确。我们在此研究了于大规模单细胞转录组集合上训练的基础模型的缩放行为。我们显示，预训练损失会随模型容量和训练算力系统性下降，并呈现对模型规模的幂律依赖。这些趋势的强度和规律性在不同模型形式之间有所不同。我们识别并量化了将最优学习率和深宽比与模型规模、深度或算力联系起来的经验关系。结果表明，缩放原则可扩展至转录组建模。更广泛地说，它们为估计增加资源的预期收益、选择合适的超参数和架构提供了定量框架，从而支持开发能力不断增强的组学数据基础模型。

items.title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Automated Pathology Diagnosis and Report Generation
items.abstract_or_text: The rapid advancement of vision-language models (VLMs) has accelerated progress in computational pathology; however, whole-slide image (WSI)-based pathology report generation remains limited by the scarcity of large-scale WSI--report datasets and the complexity of mapping spatially distributed visual patterns to structured clinical text. To address this, we introduce a clinically curated Pan-Asia WSI--report dataset of approximately 10,500 pairs from five institutions and establish the REG 2025 benchmark through a MICCAI challenge for systematic evaluation of multimodal models. We analyze submitted methods spanning pretrained VLMs, multiple-instance learning frameworks, hierarchical expert models, retrieval-augmented generation, and cross-modal Transformers. Rather than indicating that VLM use alone was sufficient for superior performance, the results suggest that top-performing methods benefited from structured report representations, hierarchical diagnostic decomposition, and effective multimodal grounding. We identify key limitations, including instability in quantitative attribute estimation (e.g., numeric hallucination) and a tendency toward diagnostic overspecification, with some errors resembling known diagnostic pitfalls in routine pathology. These findings establish REG 2025 as a benchmark for evaluating WSI-based structured report generation and vision-language understanding in computational pathology, providing insights for the design of clinically grounded multimodal pathology models.
items.summary_zh: REG 2025以约10,500对、来自5家机构的经临床整理WSI-报告数据评估病理视觉语言模型，并系统分析结构化表示、诊断分解和多模态对齐的作用及数值幻觉等失败模式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模多机构病理报告生成基准把评估重点放在临床文本的结构化和模型失误上，为后续模型比较提供了较高价值的公共参照。
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）的快速进展推动了计算病理学的发展；然而，基于全切片图像（WSI）的病理报告生成仍受限于大规模WSI—报告数据集的稀缺，以及将空间分布的视觉模式映射到结构化临床文本的复杂性。为此，我们引入一个经过临床整理的泛亚洲WSI—报告数据集，包含来自5家机构的约10,500对数据，并通过MICCAI挑战赛建立REG 2025基准，以系统评估多模态模型。我们分析了参赛方法，包括预训练VLM、多实例学习框架、分层专家模型、检索增强生成和跨模态Transformer。结果并未表明单独使用VLM便足以获得更优性能；表现最好的方法似乎受益于结构化报告表示、层级化诊断分解和有效的多模态对齐。我们识别出关键局限，包括定量属性估计不稳定（如数值幻觉）以及诊断过度具体化倾向，其中一些错误类似于常规病理诊断中的已知陷阱。这些发现将REG 2025建立为评估基于WSI的结构化报告生成和视觉语言理解的基准，并为设计有临床依据的多模态病理模型提供见解。

items.title: TigerAI: An AI-powered genetic evidence platform to support clinical development
items.abstract_or_text: Genetic evidence is a major determinant of clinical success in drug development, yet its aggregation has long relied on laborious human curation. Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to rapidly synthesize knowledge across biomedical resources, providing a route to scalable AI-driven genetic evidence generation. Here we develop a novel domain-grounded instruction framework to systematically evaluate GPT-5 for producing genetic evidence relevant to clinical trial success. Using 13,022 target-indication pairs from a comprehensive drug development database, we benchmark LLM-derived evidence against a recent exhaustive human expert-curated study. We find that GPT-5 yields genetic evidence that is at least as informative as expert curation for inferring clinical success, while substantially expanding coverage relative to traditional curation resources. Building on these results, we introduce TigerAI (https://tigerai.bio/), a dual-purpose platform for AI-powered genetic evidence that (i) benchmarks emerging state-of-the-art LLMs and (ii) provides an accessible service for querying reliable AI-generated genetic evidence. These contributions outline a practical, domain-grounded pathway for integrating AI-powered genetic evidence into drug development pipelines and for realizing the potential of LLMs to inform clinical success.
items.summary_zh: TigerAI用13,022个靶点-适应症对比较GPT-5生成的遗传证据与专家人工整理结果，并提供面向临床开发的查询与模型评测平台。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 遗传证据与药物临床成功密切相关；该工作提出面向真实药物开发数据库的可扩展评测，但“至少同等信息量”的主张仍来自预印本中的特定比较设计。
items.abstract_zh: 遗传证据是药物开发中临床成功的重要决定因素，但其汇集长期依赖耗费人力的人工整理。大语言模型（LLMs）有可能快速综合跨生物医学资源的知识，为可扩展的AI驱动遗传证据生成提供路径。我们在此开发了一种新的领域扎根式指令框架，以系统评估GPT-5生成与临床试验成功相关遗传证据的能力。我们使用综合药物开发数据库中的13,022个靶点-适应症对，将LLM生成的证据与近期一项穷尽性人类专家整理研究进行基准比较。我们发现，在推断临床成功方面，GPT-5产生的遗传证据至少与专家整理同样具有信息量，同时相较传统整理资源显著扩大了覆盖范围。在这些结果基础上，我们推出TigerAI（https://tigerai.bio/），这是一个双用途AI驱动遗传证据平台：（i）对新兴的先进LLM进行基准测试；（ii）提供查询可靠AI生成遗传证据的易用服务。这些贡献勾勒出一条将AI驱动遗传证据整合入药物开发流程的实用途径，并有助于实现LLMs为临床成功提供信息的潜力。

items.title: Development and external validation of a machine learning screening model for broad sleep health disturbance in patients with osteoarthritis
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Broad sleep health disturbance is a highly prevalent but underrecognized comorbidity in osteoarthritis (OA), and practical screening tools are needed to identify OA patients who may require further sleep assessment. This study aimed to develop and validate a machine learning-based screening model for broad sleep health disturbance in OA patients using routinely available clinical variables. Model generalizability was further assessed through independent external validation. Methods Data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2007–2018 were analyzed. A total of 3,636 participants with OA were included. Broad sleep health disturbance was defined as self-reported physician consultation for sleep problems, physician-diagnosed sleep disorder, or frequent excessive daytime sleepiness. LASSO regression with 10-fold cross-validation was employed for feature selection from 32 candidate variables. Seven machine learning classifiers—logistic regression, decision tree, random forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, support vector machine (SVM), and artificial neural network (ANN)—were constructed and evaluated on a held-out validation set (7:3 split). Model performance was assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration curves, Brier scores, and decision curve analysis. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) was applied to interpret the best-performing screening model. External validation was performed using a prospectively collected cohort of 320 OA patients from Anxi County Hospital, China, and model discrimination, calibration, and clinical utility were assessed. Results Twelve variables were retained by LASSO regression. Among all models, XGBoost achieved the highest AUC (0.733, 95% CI: 0.702–0.763), the lowest Brier score (0.199), and the greatest net benefit on decision curve analysis. SHAP analysis identified sleep duration as the most influential predictor, followed by age, depression, cardiovascular disease, hypertension, diabetes, and BMI, all of which aligned with established clinical mechanisms. In external validation, the ANN model achieved the highest AUC of 0.884 (95% CI: 0.847–0.920), while XGBoost—the best-performing model in the development cohort—yielded an AUC of 0.860 (95% CI: 0.816–0.901), both exceeding their internal validation estimates. Conclusion A machine learning screening model based on routinely available clinical variables was developed to identify broad sleep health disturbance in OA patients, with XGBoost demonstrating the best overall performance in the development cohort. The key predictors identified align closely with known biological and clinical pathways linking OA to sleep disturbance. External validation confirmed robust model performance across populations, suggesting that this tool may assist orthopedic clinicians in preliminary identification of patients who may benefit from further sleep assessment.
items.summary_zh: 研究基于NHANES 2007–2018中3,636名骨关节炎患者开发睡眠健康障碍筛查模型，并在中国320名患者的前瞻性外部队列验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 内部比较多种模型并纳入独立外部验证，增强了其初步可信度；模型适用于进一步睡眠评估前的筛查，不能据此替代诊断。
items.abstract_zh: 广泛睡眠健康障碍是骨关节炎（OA）中高发但认识不足的共病，因此需要实用筛查工具来识别可能需要进一步睡眠评估的OA患者。本研究旨在利用常规可得的临床变量，开发并验证用于OA患者广泛睡眠健康障碍的机器学习筛查模型，并通过独立外部验证进一步评估模型泛化性。方法：分析National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey（NHANES）2007–2018数据，共纳入3,636名OA参与者。广泛睡眠健康障碍定义为因睡眠问题自行报告曾就诊医师、医师诊断的睡眠障碍或频繁过度日间嗜睡。采用10折交叉验证的LASSO回归从32个候选变量中进行特征选择。构建并在留出验证集（7:3划分）上评估7种机器学习分类器——逻辑回归、决策树、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、支持向量机（SVM）和人工神经网络（ANN）。模型性能通过受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）、校准曲线、Brier评分和决策曲线分析评估。采用SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）解释表现最佳的筛查模型。使用来自中国安溪县医院前瞻性收集的320名OA患者队列进行外部验证，并评估模型的区分度、校准度和临床效用。结果：LASSO保留12个变量。在所有模型中，XGBoost获得最高AUC（0.733，95% CI：0.702–0.763）、最低Brier评分（0.199）和最大的决策曲线净获益。SHAP分析将睡眠时长识别为最有影响力的预测因子，其后为年龄、抑郁、心血管疾病、高血压、糖尿病和BMI，均与既有临床机制相符。在外部验证中，ANN取得最高AUC（0.884，95% CI：0.847–0.920）；开发队列中表现最佳的XGBoost取得AUC 0.860（95% CI：0.816–0.901），两者均高于内部验证估计。结论：基于常规可得临床变量的机器学习筛查模型已被开发，用于识别OA患者的广泛睡眠健康障碍；XGBoost在开发队列中展现出最佳整体表现。所识别的关键预测因子与已知的连接OA和睡眠障碍的生物学和临床通路高度一致。外部验证确认了模型在人群间的稳健表现，提示该工具可能帮助骨科临床医师初步识别可能受益于进一步睡眠评估的患者。
