items.title: A critical evaluation of Gene Ontology priors in biologically-informed neural networks
items.abstract_or_text: Biologically-informed neural networks (BINNs) embed prior knowledge such as the Gene Ontology (GO) into their architecture to produce structurally interpretable representations, yet whether and how this prior improves performance or interpretation remains unclear. Here, we introduce GONNECT, a BINN incorporating GO into an autoencoder. We evaluate GO constraints in the encoder, decoder, or both on RNA-seq tumour samples from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), comparing against published BINNs (OntoVAE and VEGA), randomized-prior controls, and an unconstrained baseline. Across metrics, GO structure adds little to reconstruction or latent-space organization, frequently matched by randomized or unconstrained models. Its value lies in node activations, particularly in the encoder, where they correlate with a gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA)-derived reference. GONNECT-SL introduces regularized connections outside GO, but these soft links are unstable across seeds and concentrate where the ontology is sparse, appearing to compensate for the priors constraints rather than reveal new biology. They recover near-unconstrained reconstruction, keeping encoder activations interpretable. We identify the soft-link encoder as most promising. Our results clarify what biological priors contribute: their value lies not in the identity of the imposed connections or in improved performance, but in organizing activations into biologically meaningful units that can be interrogated directly.
items.summary_zh: GONNECT在TCGA RNA-seq肿瘤样本上系统比较Gene Ontology结构先验、随机先验与无约束基线，发现GO主要提升节点激活的可解释性，未稳定改善重构或潜空间组织。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对生物知识先验网络的负向和机制性结果很重要：可解释架构中的知识先验需要与随机对照和无约束模型共同检验。
items.abstract_zh: 生物学知识引导神经网络（BINNs）将Gene Ontology（GO）等先验知识嵌入其架构，以产生在结构上可解释的表征；然而，这种先验是否以及如何改善性能或解释性仍不明确。我们在此引入GONNECT，这是一个将GO纳入自编码器的BINN。我们在The Cancer Genome Atlas（TCGA）的RNA-seq肿瘤样本上评估将GO约束置于编码器、解码器或二者中的效果，并与已发表BINNs（OntoVAE和VEGA）、随机先验对照和无约束基线进行比较。跨各项指标，GO结构对重构或潜空间组织贡献很小，且常被随机模型或无约束模型达到相同水平。其价值体现在节点激活上，特别是在编码器中：这些激活与基因集富集分析（GSEA）导出的参考结果相关。GONNECT-SL在GO之外引入正则化连接，但这些软连接在不同随机种子间不稳定，并集中于本体稀疏区域，似乎是在补偿先验约束，而非揭示新的生物学。它们恢复了接近无约束模型的重构效果，同时保持编码器激活可解释。我们认为软连接编码器最具前景。结果澄清了生物学先验的作用：其价值在于将激活组织为可直接探究的、生物学上有意义的单元，而不在于所施加连接本身的身份或性能提升。
items.author_line: Verlaan, T., Lieftinck, M. A., Mwine, W., Reinders, M. J. T.

items.title: SOVER: Formal Certification of Optimization Reformulations via LLM-Assisted SMT Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable promise in translating and reformulating complex mathematical optimization problems across modeling languages. However, validating such transformations through empirical solver executions alone is unreliable, as solver outcomes may be affected by local minima, structural timeouts, numerical artifacts, and subtle semantic divergence between formulations. We introduce SOVER, an LLM-assisted SMT framework that separates semantic mapping from formal certification: Z3 checks domain cross-feasibility and global objective-order preservation for mixed-integer linear formulations, while dReal provides tolerance-aware feasibility/range and ε-argmin checks for continuous nonlinear formulations. We also introduce NLEquiv-150, a public benchmark of 100 equivalent and 50 deliberately hard non-equivalent nonlinear reformulation pairs. With LLM-extracted mappings, SOVER classifies 149/150 pairs (99.33%) correctly, including all 50 hard negatives; the sole error is an incomplete mapping extraction.
items.summary_zh: SOVER 用 LLM 提取变量映射，再分别以 Z3 和 dReal 对混合整数线性与连续非线性优化重构进行 SMT 认证；在 NLEquiv-150 的 150 对非线性重构上报告 149 对分类正确。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将优化建模语言转换的语义对应关系与形式认证分开处理，并以刻意构造的非等价难例测试，减少仅凭求解器运行结果判断等价性的风险。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在跨建模语言翻译和重构复杂数学优化问题方面已显示出显著前景。然而，仅通过经验性的求解器运行来验证这类转换并不可靠，因为求解器结果可能受到局部极小值、结构性超时、数值伪影以及公式之间细微语义偏差的影响。我们提出 SOVER，这是一个由 LLM 辅助的 SMT 框架，将语义映射与形式认证分开：Z3 检查混合整数线性公式的定义域交叉可行性和全局目标排序保持性，而 dReal 为连续非线性公式提供考虑容差的可行性/取值范围及 ε-argmin 检查。我们还提出 NLEquiv-150，这是一个公开基准，包含 100 对等价和 50 对刻意设置为困难的非等价非线性重构对。使用 LLM 提取的映射，SOVER 正确分类了 150 对中的 149 对（99.33%），包括全部 50 个困难负例；唯一的错误来自不完整的映射提取。
items.author_line: Swapnil Bhattacharyya, Mayank Baranwal

items.title: Predicting Program Exit Code with LLMs and Programming Language Semantics
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) have shown proficiency in various software engineering tasks, such as code generation and translation. However, a key limitation in their performance may be their (lack of) understanding of programming-language semantics. Even when explicit semantics are given, it remains unclear whether LLMs apply those rules or lean on priors learned during pre-training instead. We study if LLMs lean on priors or given semantics with a novel task--Program Executability Prediction (PrEx)--that asks models to predict whether a program is semantically valid or invalid (and, if invalid, which formal rule it violates) given the program's syntax and operational semantics. Because PrEx requires both valid and invalid programs, we build a dataset with systematically generated invalid transformations derived from valid programs. We evaluate open-source coding LLMs under two semantic formalisms and two semantic shifts across Human-Written, LLM-Translated, and Fuzzer-Generated program splits. Our findings show that LLMs lean on pre-training priors rather than systematically applying the given rules, performing especially poorly on modified semantics and degrading further as program complexity increases. PrEx is available at https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/prex.
items.summary_zh: PrEx 要求模型依据给定程序语法和操作语义判断程序是否语义有效，并在无效时指出违反的形式规则。跨两种语义形式化和两类语义变更的实验显示，所测开源代码模型常依赖预训练先验，面对修改后的语义尤其不稳。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其系统生成的有效与无效程序实例使“是否按给定规则推理”成为可判定问题，为评估模型的形式语义能力提供了比一般代码问答更直接的测试。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）已在代码生成、代码翻译等多种软件工程任务上展现出熟练能力。然而，其表现的一个关键局限可能是其对编程语言语义的理解不足。即使给定显式语义，LLM 究竟会应用这些规则，还是会依赖预训练期间学到的先验，仍不清楚。我们通过一项新任务——程序可执行性预测（PrEx）——研究 LLM 是依赖先验还是给定语义。该任务要求模型在给定程序语法和操作语义的情况下，预测程序在语义上是否有效或无效；若无效，则指出其违反了哪条形式规则。由于 PrEx 需要同时包含有效与无效程序，我们构建了一个数据集，其中的无效变换由有效程序系统生成。我们在人工编写、LLM 翻译和模糊测试器生成的程序划分上，以两种语义形式化和两种语义变更评估开源代码 LLM。我们的发现表明，LLM 倾向于依赖预训练先验，而非系统地应用给定规则；它们在修改后的语义上表现尤其差，且随着程序复杂度提高而进一步退化。PrEx 可见于 https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/prex。
items.author_line: Lara Marinov, Aditya Thimmaiah, Jayanth Srinivasa, Junyi Jessy Li, Milos Gligoric

items.title: CordisBench: Can Language Models Reason About Component Lifecycles in Dynamic Agent Harnesses?
items.abstract_or_text: Dynamic agent harnesses let language models change the software that shapes their own execution. This flexibility brings a new reasoning burden: a local plugin change can propagate through dependencies and cleanup. We introduce CordisBench, a 1,200-question benchmark of this lifecycle reasoning. It combines a controlled formal setting with programs executed against Cordis, a runtime that manages component dependencies and cleanup, and asks models to identify affected components, predict state after a specified teardown order, determine which conditions hold under all or some orders, and choose reconfigurations that succeed when executed. Across these tasks, we evaluate three efficiency-oriented models at low reasoning effort with 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, or 32 relevant interactions, using deterministic task-specific scoring. Models usually handle small systems well but grow less reliable as more interactions become relevant, especially when predicting final state and when reasoning across teardown orders. Additional inference effort recovers marked gains for some models. The cost is nontrivial: on our 16-interaction subset, GPT-5.6 Luna uses nearly 3,000 reasoning tokens per question at medium effort. For these controlled instances, that cost is avoidable: an independent finite reference semantics agrees with Cordis execution on every observation and action outcome used for scoring across all 528 executable questions.
items.summary_zh: CordisBench 以 1,200 道组件生命周期推理题测试模型对动态 Agent harness 中依赖、清理和拆卸顺序的理解，并用确定性评分和独立有限参考语义核对 528 道可执行题。模型在交互变多时可靠性下降。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准将动态软件组件的状态推理化为可执行且有参考语义的任务，能够区分模型叙述与实际状态演算，也报告了推理预算带来的性能与 token 开销。
items.abstract_zh: 动态 Agent harness 允许语言模型改变塑造其自身执行的软件。这种灵活性带来了新的推理负担：一个局部插件修改能够通过依赖关系和清理过程传播。我们提出 CordisBench，这是一个包含 1,200 个组件生命周期推理问题的基准。它将受控的形式化设定与在 Cordis 上执行的程序相结合；Cordis 是一个管理组件依赖和清理的运行时。该基准要求模型识别受影响的组件、预测指定拆卸顺序后的状态、判断哪些条件在所有或某些顺序下成立，并选择执行后能够成功的重新配置方案。对于这些任务，我们以每题 2、4、8、16、24 或 32 次相关交互，在低推理强度下评估三个注重效率的模型，并使用确定性的任务专属评分。模型通常能够处理小型系统，但随着更多交互变得相关，其可靠性会下降，尤其是在预测最终状态及跨拆卸顺序推理时。额外的推理投入可使某些模型取得显著提升。其成本并不低：在 16 次交互的子集上，GPT-5.6 Luna 在中等推理强度下每题使用近 3,000 个推理 token。对于这些受控实例，这一成本可以避免：一个独立的有限参考语义在全部 528 个可执行问题中，就用于评分的每一项观测和动作结果均与 Cordis 执行一致。
items.author_line: Damien Sileo, Dimitri Kachler

items.title: Separating perception from reasoning in vision-language models: a model-free render ceiling for crystal structures
items.abstract_or_text: Multimodal evaluations cannot say whether a vision-language model misread an image or misreasoned about it, because every existing method for separating the two places a second model in the loop. We introduce the render ceiling, a model-free reference for benchmarks built by rendering known objects: inverting the frozen cameras and re-solving cross-view correspondence recovers exactly the answer the images support. We prove the ceiling fails only through an enumerable set of projection coincidences and certify that set empty on 2,160 rendered crystal structures, so every point of a model's deficit belongs to the model. Across fourteen vision-language models, supplying exact geometry as text lifts every model yet closes under half the gap for thirteen, while a supervised vision model with no language component reads the same images at 0.8952, above every vision-language model. The instrument exposes extraction-stage fabrication that downstream accuracy would misattribute to reasoning, yields camera-placement rules for benchmark builders, and transfers to any benchmark with an invertible forward rendering.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出无需第二模型的 render ceiling：对已知物体渲染图像反演固定相机并重求跨视角对应，以确定图像本身支持的答案。在 2,160 个晶体结构上，作者认证投影重合例集合为空，并显示十四个视觉语言模型补足精确几何文本后仍未弥合大部分差距。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它以可证明的渲染参考区分视觉提取失误和后续推理失误，避免把图像读取错误误记为推理能力问题。
items.abstract_zh: 多模态评估无法判断视觉语言模型是误读了图像还是对图像推理错误，因为现有每一种用于区分二者的方法都将第二个模型置于流程中。我们提出 render ceiling，这是一种面向由已知对象渲染而成基准的、无需模型的参考：反演固定相机并重新求解跨视角对应关系，可精确恢复图像所支持的答案。我们证明，该上限只会因一个可枚举的投影重合集合而失效；并在 2,160 个渲染晶体结构上认证该集合为空，因此模型与上限之间的每一点差距都归属于模型本身。在十四个视觉语言模型中，提供文本形式的精确几何信息会提升每一个模型，但对其中十三个模型而言，提升后仍填补不了一半差距；而一个不含语言组件的监督视觉模型在相同图像上达到 0.8952，超过了所有视觉语言模型。该工具揭示了下游准确率会错误归因于推理的提取阶段编造现象，为基准构建者给出相机放置规则，并可迁移到任何具有可逆前向渲染的基准。
items.author_line: Can Polat, Mustafa Kurban, Erchin Serpedin, Hasan Kurban

items.title: Self-Reports Are Not Verification: Environment-Grounded Auditing of LLM Operators in Evolutionary Search
items.abstract_or_text: Language model agents increasingly propose actions, observe external feedback, and explain their own behavior. Their confidence and rationales are convenient monitoring signals, but convenience is not verification. We introduce an environment-grounded audit in which every intermediate proposal receives an exact outcome. A language model operates an evolutionary Contexto search whose feedback function assigns every valid guess an exact rank without human annotation. Across 200 runs spanning five configurations and three model families, four reporting configurations produce 12,249 self-reports. We test three assumptions: stated confidence is calibrated, inherited rationales affect later proposals, and fitness-based selection improves report quality. All three fail. Operators overstate top-100 success by factors of 4.8 to 9.3, while calibration and discrimination dissociate across model families. Controlled interventions on 754 inherited rationales bound any measured benefit of the genuine rationale to roughly 250 ranks. Neither fitness-based nor random selection produces a detectable selection differential or parent-to-offspring transmission in report accuracy, despite sharply different search behavior. Agent self-reports should therefore be treated as claims to verify against the environment, not as evidence of their own reliability.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在具有精确排名反馈的进化式 Contexto 搜索中，对 200 次运行、五种配置、三个模型家族的 12,249 份自我报告进行环境内审计。置信度校准、继承理由影响后续提议、基于适应度的选择提升报告质量这三项假设均未得到支持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它用每一步都有精确结果的环境检验 Agent 的自我说明，并以受控干预量化理由的实际影响，提示监测指标需要同外部结果相互核实。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型 Agent 日益能够提出行动、观察外部反馈并解释自身行为。它们的置信度和理由是方便的监测信号，但方便并不等于验证。我们引入一种以环境为依据的审计，其中每个中间提议都会得到精确结果。语言模型操作一个进化式 Contexto 搜索，其反馈函数会为每个有效猜测赋予精确排名。在涵盖五种配置和三个模型家族的 200 次运行中，四种报告配置产生了 12,249 份自我报告。我们检验三项假设：陈述的置信度是否经过校准、继承的理由是否会影响后续提议，以及基于适应度的选择是否会提升报告质量。三者均未成立。操作者对进入前 100 名成功的估计高出实际的 4.8 至 9.3 倍，而校准度和区分度在不同模型家族间并不一致。对 754 个继承理由进行的受控干预表明，真实理由带来的任何可测收益上限约为 250 个名次。尽管搜索行为显著不同，基于适应度的选择和随机选择都未产生可检测到的报告准确性选择差异或亲代到子代的传递。因而，Agent 的自我报告应被视为需要根据环境验证的主张，而非其自身可靠性的证据。
items.author_line: Enrong Pan, Ryan Zhou, Ting Hu

items.title: Retrieved but not ranked: surface-form bias in structural retrieval, from mathematics to agent trajectories
items.abstract_or_text: We evaluate embedding retrieval where surface form and meaning are pulled apart on purpose: retrieving items that share underlying structure but not wording, in two unrelated domains under one protocol, competition mathematics (MathNet-Retrieve; 500 queries, 117,088-item corpus) and embodied-agent trajectories (ALFWorld-derived; 118 queries, 336 trajectories). In mathematics the failure is complete: strict Hit@1 at the heaviest disguise tier is 0.0% for both production embedders (bootstrap 95% CI [0.0, 0.0]) while the correct item sits in the top 10 nearly always, and in 95.2 to 99.8% of misses the winner is more lexically similar to the query than the correct answer. In trajectories, where surface variation is incidental, the same models land at or near hypergeometric chance when gold must involve a different object, and below chance for all three embedders once gold must differ in object and receptacle: retrieval anchors on literal tokens, not task structure. A lexical reranker control hurts in mathematics and helps in trajectories (closing 26 to 36% of the gap, CIs excluding zero); its sign reveals whether a benchmark's surface variation is adversarial or incidental. An LLM reranker recovers 5 to 63% of the gap in mathematics and 43 to 76% in trajectories; direction replicates across three judges (all 21 cells positive), but effect sizes, tier profiles, and the outlier judge change with domain (paired differences excluding zero everywhere). Mathematics gains concentrate on well-known competitions (+19.8 points, CI [+6.7, +33.2], one of six cells), so part of the recovery is memorization. In a paired downstream experiment (210 queries, graders at 96 to 99% agreement), oracle retrieval was indistinguishable from adversarially bad retrieval (McNemar p = 0.678); the solver's 69.5% zero-shot accuracy is largely a truncation proxy (97 to 100% on finished answers), leaving no headroom.
items.summary_zh: 该工作在竞赛数学的 MathNet-Retrieve 和具身 Agent 轨迹两域中，故意拉开表面形式与底层结构。两种生产嵌入器在数学最高伪装等级的严格 Hit@1 均为 0%，但正确项几乎总在前 10；LLM 重排可恢复部分差距，但作者也检验了其中可能存在的竞赛题记忆影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将结构检索能力与词面相似性偏好直接对照，并报告置信区间、多个评判器和下游配对实验，说明“检索更接近金标准”不必然改善当前求解结果。
items.abstract_zh: 我们在两个无关领域中以同一协议评估嵌入检索，并有意将表面形式与含义分离：检索在底层结构上相同、但措辞不同的项目。两个领域分别是竞赛数学（MathNet-Retrieve；500 个查询、117,088 项语料）和具身 Agent 轨迹（源自 ALFWorld；118 个查询、336 条轨迹）。在数学中，失败是彻底的：对于两个生产嵌入器，在伪装最强等级上严格 Hit@1 都为 0.0%（bootstrap 95% CI [0.0, 0.0]），而正确项目几乎总在前 10 名中；在 95.2% 至 99.8% 的漏检中，获胜项在词汇上比正确答案更接近查询。在轨迹中，表面变化是附带的；当金标准项目必须涉及不同对象时，相同模型的表现达到或接近超几何随机机会水平；一旦金标准项目必须同时在对象和容器上不同，所有三个嵌入器都低于机会水平：检索依赖字面 token，而非任务结构。词汇重排序控制在数学中有害、在轨迹中有益（填补 26% 至 36% 的差距，置信区间不包含零）；其方向揭示基准中的表面变化是对抗性的还是附带的。LLM 重排序器在数学中恢复了 5% 至 63% 的差距，在轨迹中恢复了 43% 至 76%；这一方向在三个评判器中得到复现（全部 21 个单元格均为正），但效应大小、等级曲线和离群评判器会随领域而变（配对差异在各处都不包含零）。数学上的提升集中于知名竞赛（+19.8 点，CI [+6.7, +33.2]，六个单元格中的一个），因此部分恢复来自记忆。在一项配对下游实验中（210 个查询，评分者一致率为 96% 至 99%），oracle 检索与对抗性地糟糕的检索无可区分（McNemar p = 0.678）；求解器 69.5% 的零样本准确率在很大程度上是截断代理（对完成的答案为 97% 至 100%），没有提升空间。
items.author_line: Nabira Rashid, Manolis Kellis

items.title: Escaping Redundant Reasoning: Structure-Aware Search for Inference-Time LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Inference-time search with large language models (LLMs) often concentrates on a small set of structurally or semantically similar trajectories, leaving alternatives underexplored---a failure mode we call reasoning basin collapse. We introduce BASIN, a training-free, structure-aware selection method that groups reasoning states into basins and penalizes repeated visits to the same strategy, thereby reallocating search across genuinely distinct reasoning paths under a fixed compute budget. Under matched inference budgets, BASIN improves over Tree of Thoughts (ToT) by up to +22pp on Game of 24 and +6.7pp on MuSR. A quality-aware variant, QA-BASIN, further improves robustness by preserving high-quality basins when unconditional diversification over-explores. To explain when basin-aware selection helps, we introduce the redundancy gap Δ, which measures how differently search concentrates for correct versus incorrect predictions: standard ToT often operates near Δ\approx 0, while BASIN consistently shifts Δ positive. More broadly, BASIN suggests structure-aware selection as a simple and general approach to improving inference-time reasoning. Code can be found at https://github.com/GitHubLuCheng/basin.
items.summary_zh: BASIN 在固定推理预算下将推理状态归入不同 basin，并惩罚反复访问同一策略，以缓解推理搜索集中于相似轨迹的问题。摘要报告其相对 Tree of Thoughts 在 Game of 24 上最高提升 22 个百分点、在 MuSR 上提升 6.7 个百分点；QA-BASIN 进一步保留高质量 basin。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法给出明确的搜索冗余度量 Δ 和匹配预算下的对照，但所报告增益来自两个指定基准，尚不足以说明对各类数学证明或推理任务均有效。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的推理时搜索常集中在一小组结构或语义相似的轨迹上，使替代路径未被充分探索——我们将这一失效模式称为 reasoning basin collapse。我们提出 BASIN，这是一种无需训练、具有结构感知的选择方法；它将推理状态归入不同 basin，并惩罚对同一策略的重复访问，从而在固定计算预算下将搜索重新分配到真正不同的推理路径中。在匹配的推理预算下，BASIN 在 Game of 24 上相对 Tree of Thoughts（ToT）最高提高 22 个百分点，在 MuSR 上提高 6.7 个百分点。一个质量感知变体 QA-BASIN 通过在无条件多样化过度探索时保留高质量 basin，进一步提高稳健性。为解释何时 basin 感知选择有益，我们引入冗余差距 Δ，它衡量正确与错误预测的搜索集中程度有何不同：标准 ToT 通常运行在 Δ\approx 0 附近，而 BASIN 持续将 Δ 推向正值。更广泛地说，BASIN 表明，结构感知选择是提高推理时推理能力的一种简单且通用的方法。代码可见于 https://github.com/GitHubLuCheng/basin。
items.author_line: Lu Cheng

items.title: Generative artificial intelligence for reliable mechanistic reasoning for corrosion
items.abstract_or_text: Corrosion accounts for approximately 4% of global GDP, and reliable prediction is essential for timely mitigation. Machine learning effectively predicts corrosion rates from composition, microstructure, and environmental variables, but cannot explain the underlying mechanisms. A reliable approach in safety-critical materials engineering requires not only accurate retrieval but also mechanistically defensible reasoning, a capability that existing factuality metrics cannot assess. This work presents a domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation framework for corrosion knowledge synthesis, demonstrated on magnesium alloy corrosion. Three open-weight language models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Mistral-7B) are fine-tuned on 3,309 expert-verified question-answer pairs from 840 peer-reviewed papers and integrated with a hybrid dense-lexical retrieval pipeline. Retrieval augmentation produces Token F1 gains of 143-194%, with system faithfulness of 0.964 and context recall of 0.988. Blind external validation on newly published literature and in-house electrochemical data confirms trend-level generalisation. Reason Map, a proposition-graph framework, is further introduced; it independently constructs directed evidence graphs from generated answers and retrieved literature, enabling systematic detection of causal direction inversions and unsupported inferential leaps that flat factuality metrics cannot expose. The modular architecture can be applied across domains, offering a generalizable blueprint for trustworthy AI-assisted knowledge synthesis to circumvent corrosion, which can also be applied to other engineering domains.
items.summary_zh: 构建面向镁合金腐蚀知识综合的领域 RAG 框架：以 840 篇同行评议论文中的 3,309 组专家核验问答微调 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B 和 Mistral-7B，并以 Reason Map 识别因果方向颠倒及缺乏证据支持的推断。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把检索准确性扩展到可辩护的机理推理，并报告了新近文献和内部电化学数据的盲法外部验证；但结果主要反映趋势层面的泛化，跨材料体系与实际工程决策中的可靠性仍需进一步检验。
items.abstract_zh: 腐蚀约占全球 GDP 的 4%，可靠预测对于及时缓解腐蚀至关重要。机器学习能够根据成分、微观结构和环境变量有效预测腐蚀速率，却无法解释其深层机制。在安全关键材料工程中，可靠的方法不仅需要准确检索，也需要在机理上可辩护的推理，而现有事实性指标无法评估这种能力。本研究提出了一个用于腐蚀知识综合的领域适配检索增强生成框架，并在镁合金腐蚀上进行了展示。3 个开放权重语言模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Mistral-7B）在来自 840 篇同行评议论文的 3,309 组专家核验问答对上进行了微调，并与混合稠密—词法检索流水线整合。检索增强使 Token F1 提升 143–194%，系统忠实度达到 0.964，语境召回率达到 0.988。针对新近发表文献和内部电化学数据的盲法外部验证证实了趋势层面的泛化。研究还引入了命题图框架 Reason Map；它从生成答案和检索文献中独立构建有向证据图，从而能够系统识别因果方向反转和没有依据的推理跳跃，这是扁平化事实性指标无法揭示的。该模块化架构可应用于不同领域，为可信 AI 辅助知识综合提供了可泛化的蓝图，用于防控腐蚀，也可应用于其他工程领域。
items.author_line: Bharath M N, R K Singh Raman, Alankar Alankar

items.title: Elite-Weighted Supervised Fine-tuning for Goal-Directed Molecular Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Goal-directed optimization is essential for steering molecular generators to propose candidates with desired properties. However, it is often implemented with policy-gradient reinforcement learning, which requires a generation-trajectory log-probability whose form depends on the model architecture and generation procedure. This makes an optimizer difficult to reuse across architectures and conditional generative designs. Supervised fine-tuning needs none of that machinery, but its update is driven by a fixed dataset, so the reward never enters the update. We introduce Elite-Weighted Supervised Fine-tuning (EW-SFT), which uses reward to guide elite selection of high-scoring molecules, and updates the model by its own pretraining loss on that set. Ablations show that reward information is passed primarily through elite selection, rather than through continuous weighting within the selected set. Because the update consumes only scored molecules and the model's native loss, the same rule applies across autoregressive, masked-diffusion, and discrete-flow generators, and across de novo, motif-extension, and linker-design tasks. Under a fixed budget of 3D shape alignment oracle calls on two kinase reference compounds, EW-SFT consistently outperforms the corresponding native optimizers. It further improves goal-directed optimization under a 2D similarity oracle on four held-out references and achieves comparable performance on a sample-efficiency benchmark without a trajectory-level RL formulation. These results demonstrate that EW-SFT is a unified and effective optimizer across molecular generators, design constraints, references, and oracles.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Elite-Weighted Supervised Fine-tuning（EW-SFT），从高奖励分子中挑选精英样本，再以生成器自身预训练损失更新模型；该规则可用于自回归、masked-diffusion 和 discrete-flow 生成器，以及从头设计、基序延伸和 linker 设计任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法避免依赖特定生成轨迹的强化学习形式，并在两个 kinase 参考化合物的 3D 形状对齐预算及多个 2D 相似性任务上优于相应原生优化器；但评估依赖计算 oracle，候选的合成可行性、活性和选择性仍未得到实验确认。
items.abstract_zh: 目标导向优化对于引导分子生成器提出具有期望性质的候选物至关重要。然而，它通常采用策略梯度强化学习实现，这需要生成轨迹的对数概率，而其形式依赖于模型架构和生成过程。这使得优化器难以跨架构和条件生成设计复用。监督微调不需要这些机制，但其更新由固定数据集驱动，因此奖励从未进入更新。我们提出 Elite-Weighted Supervised Fine-tuning（EW-SFT），它利用奖励来引导对高分分子的精英选择，并通过模型在该集合上的自身预训练损失更新模型。消融实验显示，奖励信息主要通过精英选择传递，而非通过所选集合内的连续加权传递。由于该更新只消耗已评分分子和模型原生损失，同一规则可用于自回归、masked-diffusion 和 discrete-flow 生成器，也可用于从头设计、基序延伸和 linker 设计任务。在针对两种 kinase 参考化合物的固定 3D 形状对齐 oracle 调用预算下，EW-SFT 持续优于相应的原生优化器。它还在针对 4 个留出参考物的 2D 相似性 oracle 下改进了目标导向优化，并在不采用轨迹级强化学习公式的条件下，在样本效率基准上取得可比性能。这些结果表明，EW-SFT 是一种适用于分子生成器、设计约束、参考物和 oracle 的统一且有效的优化器。
items.author_line: Shiyun Wa, Yifei Wang, Anna G. Green, Simone Sciabola, Ye Wang

items.title: Uncertainty of Vision Medical Foundation Models
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate uncertainty estimation is essential for machine learning systems de- ployed in high-stakes domains such as medicine. Traditional approaches primarily rely on probability outputs from trained models (point predictions), which provide no formal guarantees on prediction coverage and often require additional calibra- tion techniques to improve reliability. In contrast, conformal prediction (region prediction) offers a principled alternative by generating prediction sets with finite- sample validity guarantees, ensuring that the ground truth is contained within the set at a specified confidence level. In this study, we explore the impact of pre-training approach, dataset scale and domain on both point and region-level uncertainty quantification, by studying domain-specific vision medical foundation models vs. general domain vision foundation models. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation across foundation models trained on retinal, histopathological, and Chest X-Rays data, applying various calibration techniques. Our results demonstrate that (1) pre-training on higher-quality domain-specific datasets along with self-supervised learning leads to better-calibrated point predictions than general domain pre-training, (2) stan- dard re-calibration methods alone cannot fully mitigate uncertainty discrepancies across models trained on different data sources, (3) domain-specific foundation model can lead to more efficient conformal prediction. These findings highlight the importance of careful model selection and the inte- gration of both point and region prediction to enhance the reliability and trust- worthiness of medical AI systems. Our work underscores the need for a holistic approach to uncertainty quantification in recent development of medical vision foundation model, ensuring robust and interpretable AI-driven decision-making.
items.summary_zh: 研究比较领域专属与通用视觉基础模型在眼底、组织病理和胸部X线数据上的点预测及保形预测不确定性，并评估校准方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把有限样本有效性保证的保形预测引入多类医学视觉基础模型比较，有助于把模型选择和不确定性报告纳入医疗AI评测。
items.abstract_zh: 准确的不确定性估计对于部署于医学等高风险领域的机器学习系统至关重要。传统方法主要依赖训练模型的概率输出（点预测），这类输出不提供预测覆盖率的正式保证，并且往往需要额外校准技术来提高可靠性。相比之下，保形预测（区域预测）提供了一种有原则的替代方案：它产生具有有限样本有效性保证的预测集合，确保真实标签以指定置信水平包含在集合中。本研究通过比较领域专属视觉医学基础模型与通用视觉基础模型，探索预训练方法、数据集规模和领域对点预测和区域层面不确定性量化的影响。我们在眼底、组织病理和胸部X线数据上训练的基础模型中开展全面评估，并应用多种校准技术。结果表明：（1）在更高质量的领域专属数据集上预训练并结合自监督学习，相比通用领域预训练可得到校准更好的点预测；（2）仅依靠标准再校准方法无法完全缓解在不同数据来源上训练模型之间的不确定性差异；（3）领域专属基础模型可带来更高效的保形预测。这些结果强调，在近期医学视觉基础模型的发展中，需要谨慎选择模型，并结合点预测与区域预测，以提升医疗AI驱动决策的可靠性和可信度。
items.author_line: Haoxu Huang, Narges Razavian

items.title: Science sandboxes measure the scientific capability of AI agents
items.abstract_or_text: Scientific progress depends not only on finding solutions, but on learning the rules that explain why they work and using that understanding to design better experiments. We introduce science sandboxes, a framework for studying this capability in AI agents through repeated cycles of experimentation, feedback, and hypothesis revision. Science sandboxes invite an agent to query the natural world in different ways, ranging from "wet" physical experiments, to "damp" predictive models trained on empirical data, to "dry" invented rules. By establishing a common experimental loop and a protocol for evaluating agents within it, science sandboxes allow assessment of both quantitative performance on specific metrics and qualitative scientific reasoning, across a spectrum of empirical verifiability. Here, we instantiate this framework in two biological settings, models of regulatory genomics and protein fitness prediction, and examine the capabilities of frontier agents. Across these settings, we could see when agents successfully optimized a quantitative metric without understanding the rules underlying the system. In particular, their scientific reasoning deteriorated when they encountered systems whose rules fell outside familiar biological priors. By highlighting such failure modes, science sandboxes make the frontier of scientific capability measurable and provide a controlled setting in which to study and ultimately expand it.
items.summary_zh: Science sandboxes为AI智能体设计重复实验、反馈和假设修订的评测框架，并在调控基因组学和蛋白质适应度预测两个生物系统中考察前沿智能体。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架试图区分优化某一指标与理解实验系统规则的能力，为面向生物研究智能体的机制性评测提供了可操作原型。
items.abstract_zh: 科学进步不仅依赖于找到解决方案，也依赖于学习解释其为何奏效的规则，并利用这种理解设计更好的实验。我们引入science sandboxes，这是一个通过重复的实验、反馈和假设修订循环研究AI智能体此类能力的框架。science sandboxes邀请智能体以不同方式查询自然世界，范围从“湿”的物理实验，到在经验数据上训练的“潮湿”预测模型，再到“干”的虚构规则。通过建立共同的实验循环和智能体评估协议，science sandboxes能够在一系列经验可验证性程度中，同时评估特定指标上的定量表现和定性科学推理。我们在两个生物学情境中实现这一框架，即调控基因组学模型和蛋白质适应度预测模型，并考察前沿智能体的能力。在这些情境中，我们能够看到智能体何时成功优化定量指标，却并未理解系统的底层规则。尤其是，当智能体遇到其熟悉生物学先验之外的规则系统时，其科学推理会恶化。通过突出这类失败模式，science sandboxes使科学能力前沿变得可测量，并提供一个受控环境来研究并最终扩展这种能力。
items.author_line: Arya S. Rao, Rodrigo I. Castro, Sager J. Gosai, Kenneth B. Hsu, Yasha Ektefaie, Shantanu Singh, Sangeeta N. Bhatia, Steven K. Reilly, Ryan Tewhey, Eric S. Lander, Pardis C. Sabeti

items.title: Cleaner Speech, Weaker Generalization: Revisiting Pitt-Derived Benchmarks for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
items.abstract_or_text: Speech-based Alzheimer's disease (AD) detection increasingly relies on speech-enhanced and curated versions of the Pitt Corpus, where speech enhancement, sample selection, and demographic balancing are often treated as beneficial preprocessing steps. However, whether these transformations improve real-world AD detection or instead affect model generalization and prediction behavior remains unclear. In this work, we revisit the role of speech preprocessing and dataset curation across widely used benchmarks for speech-based AD detection. We evaluate the speech quality of different datasets, the cross-dataset generalization of multiple deep learning models under matched and mismatched enhancement settings, and the behavior of several recent large audio-language models (LALMs). Experimental results show that across multiple supervised speech models, speech-enhanced datasets often improve in-domain performance while reducing robustness in cross-domain evaluation. Matched enhancement between training and test data alleviates, but does not eliminate, this degradation. LALMs show a similar sensitivity: enhanced datasets induce stronger class imbalance and prediction shifts than unprocessed data. These results suggest that speech preprocessing and dataset curation can substantially influence downstream AD detection behavior, indicating that ``cleaner'' speech datasets are not necessarily more reliable for real-world AD detection.
items.summary_zh: 该研究重审Pitt Corpus衍生的阿尔茨海默病语音检测基准，发现语音增强常提高域内表现，却降低跨数据集鲁棒性；大型音频语言模型也表现出类似敏感性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨域实验提醒研究者，语音清理、样本筛选和人口学平衡可能改变疾病检测的泛化行为，不能仅以域内准确率判断可靠性。
items.abstract_zh: 基于语音的阿尔茨海默病（AD）检测日益依赖Pitt Corpus经语音增强和整理后的版本，其中语音增强、样本选择和人口学平衡常被视为有益预处理步骤。然而，这些转换究竟改善现实世界AD检测，还是影响模型泛化与预测行为，仍不明确。本文重新审视语音预处理和数据集整理在广泛使用的语音AD检测基准中的作用。我们评估不同数据集的语音质量、多个深度学习模型在增强设置匹配与不匹配条件下的跨数据集泛化，以及若干近期大型音频语言模型（LALMs）的行为。实验结果显示，在多个监督式语音模型中，语音增强数据集常常提升域内表现，却降低跨域评估的稳健性。训练与测试之间匹配的增强能够缓解这种下降，却不能将其消除。LALMs表现出相似敏感性：增强数据集比未处理数据诱发更强的类别失衡和预测偏移。这些结果表明，语音预处理和数据集整理可实质性影响下游AD检测行为；“更干净”的语音数据集不一定更适合可靠的现实世界AD检测。
items.author_line: Luqi Sun, Shreeram Suresh Chandra, Lin Zhang, You-Jin Li, Brian MacWhinney, Yu Tsao, Emily Mower Provost, Berrak Sisman

items.title: LCoT-GV: Graph Attention Networks for Verifying Long Reasoning Chains in Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large Reasoning Models produce Long Chains-of-Thought (LCoTs) which involve breaking down the problem into smaller reasoning steps before reaching the conclusion. However, these steps often contain contradictions, unsupported inferences, or irrelevant steps, even when the final answer is correct. We propose Long Chain-of-Thought Graph Verifier (LCoT-GV), a graph-based framework that represents LCoTs as reasoning graphs. Each node in the graph represents a reasoning step and the edges encode semantic and logical relations. A Graph Attention Network is then trained to predict chain-of-thought correctness from the reasoning graph. We construct a new graph-oriented verification dataset from multiple reasoning benchmarks for question answering in various domains. The results show that our method is competitive with the most similar approaches.
items.summary_zh: LCoT-GV 将长思维链表示为含推理步骤及语义、逻辑关系的图，再以图注意力网络预测思维链正确性，并构建了来自多个推理问答基准的图式验证数据集。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究针对“答案正确但过程含矛盾或无依据推断”的问题提出过程核验方法；但摘要只称结果与相近方法具有竞争力，未给出具体数值。
items.abstract_zh: 大推理模型会生成长思维链（LCoTs），即在得出结论前将问题拆分为较小的推理步骤。然而，即使最终答案正确，这些步骤也常包含矛盾、缺乏支持的推断或无关步骤。我们提出 Long Chain-of-Thought Graph Verifier（LCoT-GV），这是一个将 LCoT 表示为推理图的图方法框架。图中的每个节点表示一个推理步骤，边则编码语义与逻辑关系。随后，训练一个图注意力网络，根据推理图预测思维链的正确性。我们从多个不同领域的问答推理基准构建了一个新的面向图的验证数据集。结果表明，我们的方法与最相近的方法具有竞争力。
items.author_line: Bérénice Jaulmes, Mehwish Alam

items.title: Geometry-aware Latent Autoregressive Generative Model for PDEs in Complex Domains
items.abstract_or_text: Solving multiphysics partial differential equations (PDEs) remains a major challenge in scientific computing, especially for highly complex μm-scale tortuous geometries critical to energy and chemical engineering. We address this challenge by proposing a Geometry-aware Latent Autoregressive generative Model for PDEs (GeoLAMP) for solving physics within highly irregular and tortuous structures. GeoLAMP introduces a dual-encoder architecture on graph representations to jointly capture global topology and fine-scale geometric features, enabling an effective transition from real-space fields to compact latent representations. In the latent space, we propose a causal self-attention transformer with flow matching to model temporal dynamics, allowing stable and scalable block-wise autoregressive prediction. A flexible decoder reconstructs high-resolution physical fields on arbitrary points. We establish three multiphysics benchmark datasets in complex geometries, covering reactive flow, heat convection, and elasticity. GeoLAMP consistently achieves the most stable autoregression performance on these datasets, maintaining low errors throughout the entire rollout horizon. Our results provide a systematic study of geometry-aware learning for PDEs in μm-scale complex geometries and offer new insights into block-wise time marching of latent autoregressive PDE modeling via a flow matching framework.
items.summary_zh: GeoLAMP 面向复杂几何中的多物理场 PDE，结合图表示的双编码器、潜空间因果自注意力与 flow matching，并建立反应流、热对流和弹性三个基准数据集。摘要称其在这些数据集上保持了稳定的自回归误差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把几何与拓扑信息、时序预测和 PDE 物理场重建放在同一可评测任务中，为复杂区域上的学习型数值建模提供了具体比较对象。
items.abstract_zh: 求解多物理场偏微分方程（PDEs）仍是科学计算中的重大挑战，特别是对于能源和化学工程中关键的、高度复杂的微米尺度曲折几何。我们通过提出用于在高度不规则且曲折结构内求解物理问题的 Geometry-aware Latent Autoregressive generative Model for PDEs（GeoLAMP）来应对这一挑战。GeoLAMP 在图表示上引入双编码器架构，以联合捕获全局拓扑与细尺度几何特征，从而实现从实空间物理场到紧凑潜表示的有效转换。在潜空间中，我们提出结合 flow matching 的因果自注意力 Transformer 来建模时间动力学，实现稳定且可扩展的分块自回归预测。一个灵活的解码器可在任意点重建高分辨率物理场。我们在复杂几何中建立了三个多物理场基准数据集，涵盖反应流、热对流和弹性。GeoLAMP 在这些数据集上持续取得最稳定的自回归表现，并在整个滚动预测时域内保持低误差。我们的结果系统研究了微米尺度复杂几何中面向 PDE 的几何感知学习，并通过 flow matching 框架为潜空间自回归 PDE 建模中的分块时间推进提供了新见解。

items.title: Functional Biomaterials, Spatial Biosensing, and Artificial Intelligence
items.abstract_or_text: Recent advances in bioengineering mark a paradigm shift from passive structural scaffolding toward dynamic, interactive platforms capable of modulating and continuously monitoring the cellular microenvironment. This review explores the convergence of functional biomaterials, spatial biosensing architectures, and artificial intelligence (AI) in decoding and steering complex cell behavior. Responsive hydrogels, nanozymes, metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), and conductive scaffolds serve as information-generating systems that adapt to microenvironmental cues and produce measurable bio-signals. Concurrently, microfluidic organ-on-a-chip architectures integrated with continuous electrochemical, plasmonic, and field-effect transistor sensors enable real-time, non-destructive tracking of cellular secretions and metabolic gradients. To process these high-dimensional multimodal streams, machine learning models—ranging from explainable AI and neural networks to generative transformers and digital twins—are deployed for biomaterial optimization, label-free spectral fingerprinting, and spatial deconvolution. Finally, we highlight the application of these integrated bio-platforms in cancer modeling, liquid biopsy analytics, regenerative medicine, and closed-loop wound theranostics while addressing key hurdles in biofouling, dataset integration, and industrial scalability.
items.summary_zh: 综述功能性生物材料、空间生物传感与 AI 的结合，讨论响应性水凝胶、nanozymes、MOFs、导电支架及器官芯片传感如何产生多模态细胞微环境数据，并用于材料优化、无标记光谱指纹和空间解卷积。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为“材料—传感—AI”一体化生物平台提供了较完整的技术图景，可启发癌症模型、液体活检与再生医学中的闭环设计；但本文为综述，尚未给出统一数据集或新的实验验证，工业可扩展性和生物污损问题仍待实证。
items.abstract_zh: 生物工程的近期进展标志着一种范式转变：从被动的结构支架转向能够调控并持续监测细胞微环境的动态、交互式平台。本综述探讨了功能性生物材料、空间生物传感架构和人工智能（AI）在解析和引导复杂细胞行为中的汇合。响应性水凝胶、nanozymes、金属有机框架（MOFs）和导电支架可作为信息生成系统，适应微环境线索并产生可测量的生物信号。与此同时，集成连续电化学、等离子体和场效应晶体管传感器的微流控器官芯片架构，可实时、无损地追踪细胞分泌物和代谢梯度。为处理这些高维多模态数据流，机器学习模型——从可解释 AI 和神经网络，到生成式 transformers 和数字孪生——被用于生物材料优化、无标记光谱指纹识别和空间解卷积。最后，我们重点介绍这些整合生物平台在癌症建模、液体活检分析、再生医学和闭环伤口诊疗中的应用，同时讨论生物污损、数据集整合和工业规模化的关键难题。

items.abstract_or_text: meet @mostik_ai! what happens when you put 12 PhDs in one room for four months? first place on the ARC-AGI leaderboard, which I can't say much about while the competition is still running. and this, which I can. everyone's arguing about whether open models will catch up to frontier models. we think it's the wrong question. here's the one we pose: why does a frontier model have to generate your answer at all, when the only thing you need from it is the reasoning? we do this by enabling models to communicate in latent space. through our protocol, hidden states pass straight from a frontier model into a small one running on your infrastructure -- no text between them, and neither model is fine-tuned. two models from different families, sharing reasoning, both left untouched. how do we know it works? we tested it on a setup where a 753B model reads the problem, and a 4B edge-class model writes the answer. with this approach, we get results 80% as accurate as the frontier model, but at 20x faster performance. we're committed to preventing frontier model lock-in and are already partnering with inference providers to accelerate open-weight adoption. we've done this between 15 of us, in four months, 12 PhDs and a Fields medalist, backed by @generalcatalyst WIRED has the first external account of the company and the work:

items.title: @Aliaian：Autonomous agent trading will be one of the next major narratives, especially on Robinhood Chain. Logos is building the
items.abstract_or_text: Autonomous agent trading will be one of the next major narratives, especially on Robinhood Chain. Logos is building the thing that stops the agent from going completely off the rails once it has access to real money The problem with autonomous trading is that prompts aren’t real risk management. You can tell an agent "never use leverage" or "never put more than 10% into one stock," but frontier models hallucinate, misunderstand instructions and behave unpredictably That obviously doesn’t work when an agent controls a serious portfolio. Logos turns those instructions into hard, machine enforced portfolio mandates: > Maximum position sizes > Minimum cash balances > Approved assets > No leverage > Maximum order sizes > Exposure and concentration limits The agent can propose whatever trade it wants, but before execution Logos checks what the portfolio would look like after the trade. If one of the rules is broken, the trade is refused. The interesting part is how they prove the checker is actually enforcing the mandate correctly. Logos uses Aristotle, the automated theorem prover developed by @HarmonicMath, the AI math company co founded by @vladtenev, to help generate formal proofs around the trading rules. Those proofs are then independently checked by Lean

items.abstract_or_text: Nature Biotechnology: drug discovery is moving from brute-force screening to intelligent search across chemical space. A new open-source platform, AdaptiveFlow, makes ultralarge virtual screening dramatically more scalable. The numbers are wild: • 69 BILLION ready-to-dock molecules from Enamine REAL Space • Chemical space organized into an 18-dimensional property grid • Target-guided screening + optional active learning to focus compute on promising regions • >1,500 docking protocols supported • Near-linear scaling to 5.6 million vCPUs on AWS • Experimentally validated nanomolar inhibitors against FSP1 and PARP1 The key idea isn’t to dock every molecule. AdaptiveFlow learns where in a 69-billion-molecule chemical universe it is worth looking — turning ultralarge virtual screening from brute-force computation into an adaptive search problem. A pretty striking example of AI changing not just how molecules are generated, but how chemical space itself is explored. Nature Biotechnology, published Sept. 1, 2026.
